hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 光環, 觸發
法術,範圍效果,光環,觸發
施放一個光環使範圍內敵人致盲。
hiddenEn: Casts an aura that blinds enemies in a radius.

hiddenZh: 法術, 捷光環, 召喚物, 混沌, 物理
法術,捷光環,召喚物,混沌,物理
獲得一個增益效果給予更多中毒傷害並且有機率造成中毒。當你有此增益效果使敵人中毒時，你會獲得毒性並且召喚一個使用投射物和範圍攻擊的苦痛毒蛛蠍。你將會隨著時間的流逝而失去毒性，頻繁的使用將會使你有更多的毒性。當你沒有毒性時，苦痛毒蛛蠍就會死亡。
hiddenEn: Grants a buff giving more poison damage and a chance to inflict poison. When you poison an enemy while you have this buff, you gain Virulence, and summon an Agony Crawler minion that uses projectile and area attacks. You will lose Virulence over time, at a rate which increases the more Virulence you have. The minion will die when you have no Virulence.

hiddenZh: 法術, 混沌, 範圍效果, 引導, 持續時間
法術,混沌,範圍效果,引導,持續時間
對你前方的敵人套用一個減益效果，對其造成持續的混沌傷害。那些尚未受到萎滅減益的敵人還會在較短的次要時間內受到阻礙效果，減緩其移動速度。持續引導將為減益效果添加傷害層，每層都有自己的持續時間。
hiddenEn: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

hiddenZh: 範圍效果, 法術, 閃電
當被號令時，這個接肢會召喚出一片抓握之手，每隻手都緊握著一顆削弱性的雷光球。當敵人接近某隻手時，其所握持的雷光球將會引爆，造成閃電傷害並在命中時施加殘喘。
hiddenEn: When commanded, this Graft will summon forth a field of grasping hands, each of which clutches an enervating orb of Lightning. When an Enemy is near a hand, the orb it clutches will detonate to deal Lightning Damage and Sap on Hit.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理, 混沌, 球體
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,物理,混沌,球體
製造一個虛無玉，阻礙它附近的敵人，越靠近它的敵人會受到更強大的減益效果。它同時會定期釋放範圍傷害的脈衝。虛無玉會吞噬在他附近死亡敵人的屍體。同時只能有一個虛無玉。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Duration, Physical, Chaos, Orb

Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,物理,持續時間
從天空降下的虛空武器，對敵人連續發射造成傷害。敵人可被擊中複數次。
暴擊, 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 持續時間
暴擊,法術,範圍效果,物理,持續時間
hiddenEn: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 物理
向前依弧形射出虛空匕首，造成物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 法術, 持續時間
將所有由你控制的召喚物召回你的所在之處，並短暫的使它們獲得生命恢復效果。
法術, 持續時間, 召喚物
hiddenEn: Recalls all minions that are following you to your location, and grants them a temporary life regeneration effect.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 冰冷
陷阱,法術,持續時間,範圍效果,冰冷
投擲一個陷阱對會附近的敵人發射減益狀態射線持續一段時間。射線會使敵人冰緩並造成冰冷持續傷害。射線同時也會影響你，根據射線影響的敵人提供你生命和魔力回復。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. A beam is also applied to you, granting life and mana regeneration based on the number of debuff beams affecting enemies.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 法術, 持續時間
獻祭一具屍體，短暫的強化與加速你的召喚物。這個技能會持續獻祭附近的屍體，每具獻祭的屍體將會延長強化召喚物的時間。
hiddenEn: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 光環, 範圍效果, 姿態, 物理
法術,光環,範圍效果,姿態,物理
根據不同的姿態，以光環賦予自己增益效果並影響附近的敵人。兩種姿態都會對越靠近你的敵人產生較大的影響。再次使用此技能會在血腥姿態和沙姿態之間進行切換。
hiddenEn: Buffs you, and affects nearby enemies with an aura, differently depending on your stance. Both stances are more impactful against enemies closer to you. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.

hiddenZh: 根據你的姿態獲得不同的近戰技能加成效果。再次使用技能可以切換血腥姿態和沙戮姿態。
hiddenEn: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰
對前方區域攻擊。每個擊中敵人的衝擊波獲得疊層。若是一段時間內沒有使用衝擊波擊中敵人時會開始失去疊層。限定匕首、爪、單手劍。
hiddenEn: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 詛咒, 咒術
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,詛咒,咒術
對目標區域降下詛咒，受到詛咒的敵人降低命中和造成更少傷害。
hiddenEn: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 弓箭
對不同的目標射出多重箭矢。
hiddenEn: Fires multiple arrows at different targets.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
重擊地面並製造出一道向前釋放的衝擊波，被此衝擊波擊中的敵人將會受到傷害並有較高機率被擊暈。衝擊波對近距離的敵人造成更多傷害。限定斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
使用你的武器打擊地面，使矛從地面刺出。在血腥姿態時，這些矛會在你指定的位置貫穿多次，在沙戮姿態時，從指定位置向四方進行貫穿。限定劍和斧。預設血腥姿態。
hiddenEn: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

hiddenZh: 戰吼, 範圍效果, 持續時間
戰吼,範圍效果,持續時間
使用戰吼嘲諷周圍所有敵人，強迫他們攻擊自己，並竭盡接下來的重擊攻擊。使用者和附近友方會獲得一個增加護甲和暈眩門檻的增益效果。
hiddenEn: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent slam attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that increases their armour and stun threshold.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 混沌
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,混沌
腐化一塊地面，基於當前區域內的怪物生成屍體，並對敵人造成持續性的混沌傷害。如果你正在使用喚醒幽魂技能，有機率生成與你最近召喚的幽魂同樣的幽魂亡體。除了召喚物技能外，不能以其他方式與幽魂亡體互動。
hiddenEn: Desecrates the ground, spawning corpses based on monsters in the current area and dealing chaos damage over time to enemies. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 冰冷, 閃電, 新星
法術,範圍效果,火焰,冰冷,閃電,新星
釋放角色身上所有的充能球並對周圍所有敵人造成元素傷害。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Nova
Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 弓箭
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,弓箭
朝最終目標後的地面發射一支箭矢，並栓住靠近的敵人。被誘捕的敵人在試圖逃脫時有移動速度會降低。若敵人離開範圍效果誘捕將失效。
hiddenEn: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.

hiddenZh: 圖騰, 法術, 範圍效果
召喚一個圖騰，它會持續的嘲諷周圍的敵人對其進行攻擊。
hiddenEn: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 投射物, 連鎖, 範圍效果, 法術, 誓約
卓越,投射物,連鎖,範圍效果,法術,誓約
施放一項誓約，強化那些會發射投射物、對目標地點周圍區域施加效果，或發射連鎖光束的非引導法術，使其造成更多傷害並強化覆蓋範圍。然而，使用此技能也會使你背負一項苦難。
hiddenEn: Exceptional, Projectile, Chaining, AoE, Spell, Pact

Cast a pact, Empowering non-channelling spells that either fire projectiles, apply an effect to an area around a targeted location or fire chaining beams, causing them to deal more damage and have enhanced coverage. However, using this skill also burdens you with an Affliction.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 閃電, 持續時間, 烙印
法術,範圍效果,物理,閃電,持續時間,烙印
製造 1 道魔幻烙印附著在鄰近敵人身上。烙印會定期啟動，對附著的敵人施加能量。一旦烙印的敵人身上能量達到 20 層，便會引發劇烈爆炸，並移除烙印。所有能量會隨著烙印一同移除。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Physical, Lightning, Duration, Brand

Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy. When the branded enemy reaches 20 energy, a large explosion occurs and the brand is removed. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間, 物理, 閃電, 範圍效果
法術,召喚物,持續時間,物理,閃電,範圍效果
對範圍內敵人造成傷害，套用一小段時間的減益效果。若非傳奇敵人被此減益效果影響時死亡，屍體會被消耗來召喚 1 個二階持續時間的赦免護衛，或是若你的護衛數量達最大上限，則刷新現有的生命和持續時間。
hiddenEn: Spell, Minion, Duration, Physical, Lightning, AoE

Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 位移, 快行, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,位移,快行,重擊
朝著目標區域躍起，並在落地時以你的武器重擊並擊退範圍內的敵人。被踩到的敵人將會被推出去。限定斧、錘、權杖、劍或是長杖。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Movement, Travel, Slam
Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果
施放一個光環，使你與受光環影響友方獲得額外的移動速度、攻擊速度以及施放速度。
hiddenEn: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 位移, 快行, 閃現
執行一系列快速的傳送，朝向指定位置，如果會與怪物或地形重疊則停止。如果使用「原地攻擊」選項，則方向相反。與其他閃現技能共用冷卻時間。不能被輔助。
hiddenEn: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location, stopping if you would overlap with monsters or terrain. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be supported.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 位移, 快行
迅速穿越敵人並同時造成武器傷害。如果雙持武器攻擊，會使用兩把武器打出一次性傷害。限定匕首、爪以及單手劍。
hiddenEn: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間
投擲一個陷阱，觸發該陷阱的敵人將會短暫的轉化為你的手下為你而戰。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 連結
以一名友方玩家為目標施放一個增益效果，在一段時間內將你和他們連結起來。連結時，他們會複製你的格擋率，並在他們格擋時回復生命。如果目標在連結時死亡，你也會死亡。該技能不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they copy your block chance and recover life when they block. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 連結
以一名友方玩家為目標施放一個增益效果，在一段時間內將你和他們連結起來。連結時，你的生命偷取回復改套用至他們。如果目標在連結時死亡，你也會死亡。該技能不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they get recovery from your life leech instead of you. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 連結, 火焰
法術,持續時間,連結,火焰
以一名友方玩家為目標施放一個增益效果，在一段時間內將你和他們連結起來。連結時，他們會根據你的生命造成額外火焰傷害。如果目標在連結時死亡，你也會死亡。該技能不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 觸發, 法術, 持續時間, 連結
觸發,法術,持續時間,連結
輔助法術技能，使它們被連結：直覺觸發。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。瓦爾技能、引導時施放技能和保留技能無法被觸發。
以一名友方玩家為目標施放一個增益效果，在一段時間內將你和他們連結起來。連結時，他們的命中可以觸發你輔助的法術。如果目標在連結時死亡，你也會死亡。該技能不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Supports spell skills, causing them to be triggered by Intuitive Link. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their hits can trigger your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 法術, 持續時間, 連結
暴擊,法術,持續時間,連結
以一名友方玩家為目標施放一個增益效果，在一段時間內將你和他們連結起來。連結時，他們使用你的主手暴擊率。如果目標在連結時死亡，你也會死亡。該技能不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 連結
以一名友方玩家為目標施放一個增益效果，在一段時間內將你和他們連結起來。連結時，你的能量護盾會承受他們受到的部分傷害。如果目標在連結時死亡，你也會死亡。該技能不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 當你對敵人造成暴擊時，這個接肢會為你施加一層「震顫」。震顫會提升最大攻擊傷害，但同時承受的傷害也會增加，且最多可堆疊 10 層。
hiddenEn: On Critically Striking an Enemy, this Graft will apply a stack of Jolt to you. Jolt grants more maximum Attack Damage at the cost of taking increased Damage, and can stack up to 10 times.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 範圍效果, 物理
攻擊,近戰,範圍效果,物理
揮舞你的盾牌，在你面前形成三道衝擊波造成範圍傷害。敵人可以被兩個重疊的衝擊波擊中。
hiddenEn: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 範圍效果, 位移, 快行, 物理
攻擊,近戰,範圍效果,位移,快行,物理
向一個區域或目標衝鋒，將路線上的敵人推開並持續在你前方區域造成副手傷害。衝鋒距離越遠，造成的傷害越高，並且擊暈敵人的機率越高。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, AoE, Movement, Travel, Physical

Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing off-hand damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 投射物, 範圍效果, 連鎖, 三相
攻擊,近戰,打擊,閃電,冰冷,火焰,投射物,範圍效果,連鎖,三相
使用近戰武器打擊敵人，將部分傷害轉換為隨機的元素傷害。根據轉換成的元素釋放出爆破、閃電或冰霜。會避免連續選擇相同的元素。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Projectile, AoE, Chaining, Prismatic

Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 暴擊, 法術, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 閃電
陷阱,暴擊,法術,持續時間,範圍效果,閃電
投擲一個陷阱，一旦被觸發將會在範圍內落下多道雷電持續一段時間，造成閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Trap, Critical, Spell, Duration, AoE, Lightning
Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 物理
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,物理
揮舞斧或劍，發射撞擊時會粉碎的投射物，或是發射時就粉碎，對它們碎裂位置前方造成範圍傷害。
hiddenEn: Swing an Axe or Sword, firing projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 物理
向前突刺斧或劍，消耗你的鋼鐵碎片來使碎片在你前方成形。碎片會瞄準前方或靠近它的敵人，連續發射投射物。鋼鐵碎片透過鋼之呼喚技能取得。
hiddenEn: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward, consuming your Steel Shards to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 物理
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,物理
UNUSED Slash in an arc, hitting with all weapons and Impaling enemies hit. Enemies struck release a burst of shards backward, dealing damage behind them. Only works with Axes and Swords.
攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 物理
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,物理
發射單一投射物，在撞擊或抵達目標位置時裂化，當它裂化時會造成範圍傷害，裂化的投射物在飛行結束時會爆炸並再次造成範圍傷害。這個技能的投射物不會返回。需要劍或斧。
hiddenEn: UNUSED Slash in an arc, hitting with all weapons and Impaling enemies hit. Enemies struck release a burst of shards backward, dealing damage behind them. Only works with Axes and Swords.

Fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 守護
套用一個增益效果，在它被消耗完畢前可以替你承受部分擊中傷害。與其它守護技能共享冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Applies a buff which can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

hiddenZh: 法術, 閃電, 持續時間, 範圍效果
法術,閃電,持續時間,範圍效果
當附近有敵人時，此接肢會定期召喚帶有閃電能量的自身分身。這些分身會朝最近的敵人移動，爆炸並留下感電地面。
hiddenEn: While Enemies are nearby, this Graft will periodically bring Lightning-Imbued Clones of you into being. These Clones will move towards the nearest Enemy, detonating and leaving behind shocked ground.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 召喚物, 持續時間, 位移, 快行, 弓箭
攻擊,召喚物,持續時間,位移,快行,弓箭
對目標地點射出一支箭，當箭到達時將你傳送至目標地，並在原地留下一個你的複製體。這個複製體使用跟你一樣的弓與箭袋。
hiddenEn: Attack, Minion, Duration, Movement, Travel, Bow
Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 位移, 持續時間
攻擊,近戰,打擊,位移,持續時間
傳送至目標怪物身邊並用近戰武器對其造成傷害。若是未指定目標，則系統會為其隨機指定一隻怪物。釋放一顆狂怒球能重置其技能冷卻。
hiddenEn: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 閃電, 捷光環
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,閃電,捷光環
於手中凝聚閃電之力，為法術與攻擊附加閃電傷害。若是你擊殺了一個受到感電狀態的敵人，此技能會製造 1 個風暴，閃電將會在一小段時間內持續攻擊你附近的敵人。此技能造成的閃電傷害無法被法術傷害詞綴影響。
hiddenEn: Grants a buff which adds lightning damage to spells and attacks. If you kill a shocked enemy, this skill will create a storm, causing lightning bolts to strike enemies around you for a duration. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 位移, 閃電, 快行
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,位移,閃電,快行
在指定位置施放一個法陣，在數秒之後將你傳送過去。當傳送時，在原本位置與傳送法陣位置的敵人都會受到閃電傷害。再次施放會列隊連續使用多次傳送。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Duration, Movement, Lightning, Travel

Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 近戰, 打擊, 閃電
攻擊,投射物,近戰,打擊,閃電
在你揮舞近戰武器時凝聚閃電之力。除了轉換一部分物理傷害為閃電傷害，儲存的能量會在你揮舞時從武器釋放投射物，襲擊遠方的敵人。若近戰攻擊擊中目標，投射物不能被躲避。
hiddenEn: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as projectiles as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies. The projectiles cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 新星
法術,範圍效果,閃電,新星
在你的周圍施放環狀閃電，接著散發更大範圍的閃電新星。每次被擊中的敵人會受到閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電
光環,法術,範圍效果,閃電
施放一個光環，使你與受光環影響的友方獲得額外的閃電抗性。
hiddenEn: Casts an aura that grants lightning resistance to you and your allies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 閃電, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,閃電,弓箭
射出一發充滿閃電能量的箭矢，箭矢擊中敵人時會造成電擊，同時電擊附近一群敵人。
hiddenEn: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電
陷阱, 暴擊, 法術, 投射物, 閃電
陷阱,暴擊,法術,投射物,閃電
投擲一個陷阱，該陷阱被觸發時將會向全方位散射出閃電投射物，投射物將會對觸發及接觸到的敵人造成閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
使用兩把武器對目標同時進行攻擊並造成傷害。限定雙持（不包含法杖）。
hiddenEn: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 物理
使用近戰武器對著目標進行兩次快速的攻擊。
hiddenEn: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電
光環,法術,範圍效果,閃電
施放一個光環，使你與受光環影響友方在攻擊時額外附帶閃電傷害，並且造成更多法術閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Casts an aura that adds lightning damage to the attacks of you and your allies, and makes your spells deal more lightning damage.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電
位移, 範圍效果, 引導, 攻擊, 近戰, 閃電
位移,範圍效果,引導,攻擊,近戰,閃電
引導一個你駕馭的幻象。當它移動時你獲得層數，直到到達最大距離。你和幻影之間會根據你的攻擊速度不斷釋放脈衝傷害。停止引導後將會傳送至幻影位置，並造成最後一波傷害。限定近戰武器。
hiddenEn: Movement, AoE, Channelling, Attack, Melee, Lightning

Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to teleport to the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 近戰, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 打擊, 光環
閃電,近戰,攻擊,範圍效果,持續時間,打擊,光環
使用近戰攻擊，使閃電擊中附近 1 名敵人，造成範圍傷害。每個目標只能被此技能擊中一次。擊擊中敵人時，你會獲得一個光環效果，使你和友方獲得額外閃電傷害，此光環會持續一段時間。限定劍、斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Lightning, Melee, Attack, AoE, Duration, Strike, Aura

Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 閃電, 連鎖, 球體
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,閃電,連鎖,球體
套用一個增加感電機率的增益效果。當你有此增益效果感電敵人時，製造一個能量領域附著至感電的敵人持續一段時間，並對附近敵人造成雷電光束傷害。領域的強度取決於製造時影響敵人的感電幅度。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Duration, Lightning, Chaining, Orb

Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.

hiddenZh: 法術, 連鎖, 閃電
一道電弧從施放者射向目標，並會彈跳至另其他目標，彈不會立即彈回。每次電弧連鎖，它還會生成一條二段電弧，連鎖到主要電弧尚未擊中的另一個敵人，但這條二段電弧不能再進一步連鎖。
hiddenEn: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 弓箭
閃電,攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,弓箭
發射迅速消逝的三支電流箭矢，它們在釋放後不久就消失。這些箭矢以極大的力量射出，製造出一道閃電爆發，對你前方扇形範圍內的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 閃電
法術,投射物,持續時間,閃電
施放出多顆變幻莫測的電球，這些電球將會隨機移動直到撞到敵人或是自然消失。
hiddenEn: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 引導
暴擊,法術,範圍效果,閃電,引導
你引導施放此技能時，技能釋放電能脈衝，對你面前弧狀區域內的所有敵人造成傷害。
法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 引導
法術,範圍效果,閃電,引導
hiddenEn: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 持續時間, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,持續時間,重擊
猛擊地面，對附近區域造成傷害並裂開地面。在一段時間後，裂縫將爆發為強力的餘震。在第一個裂縫爆發之前製造的裂縫將不會產生自己的餘震。限定斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 圖騰, 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 新星
圖騰,法術,範圍效果,物理,新星
召喚一個圖騰，它會持續的震動附近的地面，擊退附近的敵人並造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around it, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,冰冷,持續時間
在指定地點製造瞬間冰爆，對範圍內敵人造成傷害。同時也對範圍產生冰緩地面，並對擴散範圍內的敵人造成持續冰冷傷害。敵人死於範圍內有機率使你獲得狂怒球。可以消耗 1 顆狂怒球無視冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

hiddenZh: 法術, 位移, 持續時間, 冰冷, 快行, 閃現, 範圍效果
法術,位移,持續時間,冰冷,快行,閃現,範圍效果
傳送至指定的位置，對你初始位置附近造成冰冷傷害並留下冰緩地面。與其它閃現技能共享冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Spell, Movement, Duration, Cold, Travel, Blink, AoE
Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 投射物
攻擊, 召喚物, 持續時間, 近戰, 打擊
攻擊,召喚物,持續時間,近戰,打擊
使用近戰攻擊打擊敵人，給予一小段時間的減益效果。若非傳奇敵人在減益效果持續時間內死亡，敵人的屍體將會被消耗並召喚一個相同稀有度和前後綴的統御護衛，持續一段時間。
hiddenEn: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 引導, 範圍效果
法術,投射物,引導,範圍效果
投擲你近戰武器的靈體版本。此靈體將會向外飛出並如同迴力鏢一般回到你的身邊，對所有碰觸到的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path.

hiddenZh: 混沌, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 投射物
混沌,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,投射物
發射一個投射物向敵人前近並穿透他們，造成混沌傷害，且造成的部分傷害偷取為能量護盾。此投射物也會對它沿路上的敵人造成短時間但強力的混沌持續傷害減益效果。
hiddenEn: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and piercing through those it hits, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it.

hiddenZh: 投擲你的近戰武器的靈體複製體。它以大螺旋型式飛行時會旋轉，對其路徑上的敵人造成傷害，並在與牆壁碰撞時彈射。
hiddenEn: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 混沌, 範圍效果
法術,投射物,持續時間,混沌,範圍效果
投射出一個造成持續性混沌傷害減益效果的投射物。一部分減益效果的傷害將會回你的生命。減益效果可以透過瘟疫擴散。
hiddenEn: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 法術, 持續時間
消耗一具屍體，給予你的召喚物增加暴擊率和暴擊加成。此技能會消耗其他在附近的屍體，每具消耗的屍體會增加持續時間。
hiddenEn: Consumes a corpse, granting increased critical strike chance and additional critical strike multiplier to your minions. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

hiddenZh: 持續時間, 火焰, 冰冷, 閃電
持續時間,火焰,冰冷,閃電
當你對敵人施加曝曬時，此接肢將會在啟動時向你施加一個為你承受擊中元素傷害的增益。
hiddenEn: When you apply exposure to an enemy, this Graft will apply a buff which takes elemental damage from hits for you while active.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 範圍效果, 持續時間
法術,投射物,範圍效果,持續時間
法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 閃電
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,閃電
在一個位置設置一個標記。經過短暫的時間後，閃電會打擊該標記附近，並在你施放的任何其他標記處也引發雷擊。
hiddenEn: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it and causing lightning strikes at any other markers you've cast.

hiddenZh: 地雷, 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 光環, 新星
地雷,法術,範圍效果,閃電,光環,新星
投擲一個地雷，引爆後對範圍造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Mine, Spell, AoE, Lightning, Aura, Nova
Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 法術, 範圍效果, 連鎖, 球體
閃電,法術,範圍效果,連鎖,球體
創造出一個靜止的帶電球體，在其範圍內以電光打擊敵人，電光可裂化並擊中更多敵人。施放速度詞綴會增加此頻率。再次使用技能會取代原先的球體。
hiddenEn: Creates a stationary electrical orb that strikes enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning that can then split to hit more enemies. Modifiers to cast speed will increase how frequently it does this. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 法術, 範圍效果, 連鎖, 持續時間, 烙印
閃電,法術,範圍效果,連鎖,持續時間,烙印
製造一個可以附著於附近敵人的魔法烙印。當附著時，會定期發動向附近敵人和他們周圍發射光束造成傷害。當敵人死亡時烙印會掉落。
hiddenEn: Lightning, Spell, AoE, Chaining, Duration, Brand

Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing beams which deal damage to nearby enemies and those around them. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 引導, 閃電, 持續時間, 秘能
法術,範圍效果,引導,閃電,持續時間,秘能
引導施放以使在地面上的符文擴散。符文在一段時間後消逝，或被符文爆破引爆時立即消失並造成圓形範圍傷害。站在符文上的敵人被阻礙，減少他們的移動速度。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Channelling, Lightning, Duration, Arcane

Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

hiddenZh: 範圍效果, 法術, 閃電, 引導, 持續時間, 物理
範圍效果,法術,閃電,引導,持續時間,物理
當你引導施放時釋放能量球，能量球會向目標區域重複彈跳，直到它們的持續時間結束，並在每次跳躍後對小範圍造成傷害。當你停止引導時，所有存留的球會引爆，對大範圍造成較高傷害。
hiddenEn: AoE, Spell, Lightning, Channelling, Duration, Physical

Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump towards the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,物理
在你的四周召喚出虛空的刀刃，以你為中心不斷飛舞旋轉，每 0.6 秒對附近的全部敵人造成傷害。越多刀刃將增加傷害並減少每次傷害的間隔。
暴擊, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理
暴擊,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,物理
hiddenEn: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 光環, 物理
法術,範圍效果,光環,物理
施放一個光環增加附近敵人承受更多物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 法術, 持續時間
獻祭一具屍體，使你的召喚物獲得格擋攻擊與法術的能力。這個技能會持續獻祭附近的屍體，每具獻祭的屍體將會延長強化召喚物的時間。
hiddenEn: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 召喚物, 持續時間, 位移, 快行, 弓箭
攻擊,召喚物,持續時間,位移,快行,弓箭
對目標地點射出一支箭，當箭到達時在目標地創造一個你的複製體。這個複製體使用跟你一樣的弓與箭袋。
hiddenEn: Attack, Minion, Duration, Movement, Travel, Bow
Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰
法術, 範圍效果, 混沌, 閃電, 新星, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,混沌,閃電,新星,持續時間
該法術的每次施展都會在短時間內為你施加一個增益效果，當該增益效果結束時，會在你附近的區域釋放一陣閃電和混沌法術傷害。被這種傷害殺死的敵人或在短時間內死亡都會爆炸。屍體的爆炸不受法術傷害詞綴的影響，也不會被反射。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Chaos, Lightning, Nova, Duration

Each cast of this spell waits for a short duration, releasing a burst of lightning and chaos spell damage in an area around you when that duration ends. Enemies killed by this damage, or shortly after, will explode. The explosions of the corpses are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 秘能
法術,範圍效果,閃電,秘能
對目標區域造成環形閃電傷害，和四個方形延伸區域造成閃電傷害，其長度將根據你剩餘的魔力。根據你遺失的魔力造成額外的閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Deals lightning damage based upon your missing mana in a circular area around the targeted location, as well as in four rectangular extensions whose lengths depend upon your remaining mana.

hiddenZh: 秘能, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 閃電
秘能,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,閃電
以秘能灌注你的長杖，降低你的魔力消耗，並增加你的格擋機率。當你格擋時，你會釋放一道秘能衝擊波，在一段持續時間內對環形區域內的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Infuses your staff with arcane energy, lowering your mana costs and increasing your chance to block. When you block, you release an arcane wave, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 召喚物
消耗一個屍體和獻祭你的部分生命，根據獻祭的生命給與召喚物生命回復和傷害加成。技能會消耗附近其他屍體，每消耗一個屍體會增加持續時間和生命回復。
hiddenEn: Consumes a corpse, and sacrifices a portion of your life, granting your minions life regeneration based on the life sacrificed, and a bonus to damage. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration and life regeneration for each corpse consumed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 物理
使用後將會給予角色時間內一個物理攻擊增益。此增益會對角色增加攻擊速度以及給予額外的生命偷取。擊殺任意敵人將會重置此增益的時間，且獲得一個狂怒球。
hiddenEn: Adds a buff that deals Physical Damage over time, while increasing Attack Speed and Life Leech. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and can grant a Frenzy Charge.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 火焰
hiddenEn: Sets an enemy on fire from a distance.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 弓箭
射出一支穿透之箭直到它抵達目標地。當它抵達目標地後，會在該地產生一道龍捲，向全方位射出飛箭，在飛行一段距離後消逝。
hiddenEn: Fires a piercing shot that travels until it reaches the targeted location. It will then fire projectiles out in all directions from that point, which will travel for a short time before disappearing.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 物理, 範圍效果, 球體
法術,持續時間,物理,範圍效果,球體
製造一個龍捲風，持續對附近的敵人造成傷害。它會向前移動一段時間，在此期間你的投射物可以它碰撞並造成傷害，就像它是敵人一樣。 然後它會在第二階段持續時間追擊敵人，並將它從你的投射物中受到的傷害的一部分反射給他們，而不是它自己的傷害。
hiddenEn: Create a Tornado that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it. It will move forward for a duration, during which your projectiles can collide with it to deal damage as though it was an enemy. Then it will chase down enemies for a secondary duration, and reflect a portion of the damage it took from your projectiles to them in addition to its own damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 冰冷, 閃電, 三相, 觸發
輔助,法術,範圍效果,火焰,冰冷,閃電,三相,觸發
輔助攻擊技能，使它們觸發三相爆發法術。不能輔助觸發型攻擊或不是你使用的攻擊。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, AoE, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Prismatic, Trigger
Supports attacks, causing them to trigger the Prismatic Burst spell. Cannot support triggered attacks or attacks used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助可擊中敵人的技能，當你有全部三元素的共鳴給予他們加成，並在擊中時給予非最高共鳴的元素共鳴。每個元素最多有 50 共鳴。不能輔助觸發型技能、立即施放技能、球體技能、烙印、有保留的技能或被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用的技能。無法調整召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have resonance of all three elements, and to grant resonance of elements other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 Resonance for each Element. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 物理, 混沌, 閃電, 輔助
卓越,物理,混沌,閃電,輔助
輔助會擊中敵人的技能，使他們在你擁有閃電、物理、或混沌不潔共鳴時獲得額外效果，並在單次擊中時獲得非最高傷害類型的不潔共鳴。每一種傷害種類的不潔共鳴最高層數為50。無法輔助觸發、立即、球體、烙印、有保留需求的技能，或由圖騰、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have unholy resonance of lightning, physical and chaos, and to grant unholy resonance of damage types other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 unholy resonance for each damage type. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 輔助, 持續時間
輔助任何你自己使用擊中敵人的技能。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill you use to hit enemies yourself. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 輔助, 法術, 觸發
當你的保護破碎時會觸發每一個被輔助的法術技能。無法輔助由圖騰、陷阱、或地雷使用的技能。瓦爾技能、引導技能、和有保留需求的技能無法被觸發。
hiddenEn: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when your Ward breaks. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何有保留的非祝福技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any non-blessing skill with a reservation.

hiddenZh: 冰冷, 火焰, 閃電, 輔助, 範圍效果
冰冷,火焰,閃電,輔助,範圍效果
輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能，或造成元素異常狀態。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or could otherwise apply elemental ailments.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能，擊中穿透敵人元素抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

hiddenZh: 輔助製造召喚物的技能。
輔助任何可擊中或燃燒敵人，或造成元素異常狀態的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 近戰, 攻擊, 打擊
輔助近戰打擊技能，使近戰攻擊同時多的目標。額外的目標必須要在使用者的最小範圍內。如果輔助召喚物攻擊技能，召喚物的攻擊技能不會攻擊多數目標。不能輔助瓦爾或觸發技能。
hiddenEn: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 法術, 召喚物, 物理, 輔助
卓越,法術,召喚物,物理,輔助
輔助會擊中敵人的法術。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spell skills that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 輔助, 召喚物
輔助會創造召喚物的技能。
輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能，擊中穿透敵人冰冷抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

hiddenZh: 冰冷, 輔助, 連結, 持續時間
冰冷,輔助,連結,持續時間
輔助擁有冷卻時間的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that have a cooldown. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 混沌, 物理, 攻擊, 輔助, 持續時間
混沌,物理,攻擊,輔助,持續時間
輔助投射物技能，使投射物在擊中目標時分裂成兩個。
hiddenEn: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first time they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

hiddenZh: 物理, 輔助, 近戰, 攻擊, 打擊, 持續時間
物理,輔助,近戰,攻擊,打擊,持續時間
輔助不帶有創傷的近戰打擊技能。不能輔助觸發型、瓦爾技能或不是你使用的技能。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Physical, Support, Melee, Attack, Strike, Duration
Supports melee strike skills that do not inherently apply Trauma. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發, 攻擊, 持續時間
輔助,範圍效果,觸發,攻擊,持續時間
輔助法杖攻擊技能，擊殺時有機率觸發力量流束。無法輔助被觸發的技能或由其他物體施放的技能。無法改變召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Wand Attacks, granting them a chance to trigger Kinetic Flux on kill. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 觸發
當受到一定程度的傷害時會觸發所有輔助的寶石。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。瓦爾技能、引導時施放技能和保留技能無法被觸發。
hiddenEn: Each supported spell skill will track damage you take, and be triggered when the total damage taken reaches a threshold. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

hiddenZh: 輔助能擊中敵人或創造召喚物的技能。當技能或召喚物擊殺敵人，或擊中稀有、傳奇敵人時，它們有機會召喚幻影，幻影會使用穿透的投射物法術造成物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can hit enemies, or create minions. When those skills or minions kill enemies, or hit rare or unique enemies they will have a chance to summon a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助製造召喚物的技能。
輔助製造召喚物的技能。
位移, 輔助, 召喚物
輔助製造召喚物的技能。
輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助影響你和友方的光環技能，增加光環對友方的效果，但光環不再對你產生效果。不能輔助詛咒光環或其他可對敵人造成效果的光環。不能輔助被圖騰使用的技能。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可以擊中敵人的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 輔助, 咒術, 法術, 混沌
卓越,範圍效果,持續時間,輔助,咒術,法術,混沌
輔助非光環的咒術詛咒技能。
hiddenEn: Exceptional, AoE, Duration, Support, Hex, Spell, Chaos

hiddenZh: 輔助咒術詛咒技能。來自光環或詛咒地面的咒術不能被轉移。
hiddenEn: Supports hex curse skills. Hexes from auras or cursed ground cannot transfer.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 咒術, 觸發
一定要同時輔助可擊中敵人的技能和咒術技能。技能擊中時會施放咒術。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。
hiddenEn: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 輔助, 咒術
輔助任何技能。召喚物、圖騰、陷阱和地雷無法獲得啟發球。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill. Minions, Totems, Traps and Mines cannot gain Inspiration Charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能寶石。當此寶石到達 2 等以上，會讓被輔助的寶石套用消耗和保留加成。不能輔助來自非寶石的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 物理, 輔助, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊技能，對流血的敵人造成更多傷害，但技能不再對敵人造成流血。
hiddenEn: Supports melee attack skills, causing them to deal more damage against bleeding enemies, but preventing those skills from inflicting bleeding on enemies in any way.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊, 範圍效果, 輔助, 圖騰
攻擊,近戰,重擊,範圍效果,輔助,圖騰
輔助重擊技能，使他們召喚一個先祖圖騰，在你靠近它時為你使用該技能。靠近它可以增加近戰技能的效果範圍。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Slam, AoE, Support, Totem
Supports slam skills, causing them to summon an ancestor totem that uses the skill for you while you're near it. Being near it grants you increased area of effect for melee skills.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 輔助, 地雷
輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何範圍效果的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill with an area of effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能寶石。當此寶石到達 2 等以上，會讓輔助的寶石有額外的品質。不能輔助來自非寶石的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 輔助
輔助近戰攻擊技能，使用時技能重複兩次，每次隨機瞄準敵人。不能輔助瓦爾、引導施放、快行、復仇和觸發技能。
hiddenEn: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat twice when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助陷阱技能，一次投擲額外的陷阱。
hiddenEn: Supports traps skills, making them throw extra traps in a line.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 暴擊, 輔助
輔助攻擊技能。不能輔助製造召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 光環, 祝福, 召喚物
必須同時輔助可以創造召喚物且召喚物可被傷害，
和在你附近創造永久光環的技能。
不能輔助觸發型技能、鬥旗技能或姿態技能。
hiddenEn: Must support both a skill that creates minions which can be damaged, and
an aura skill that creates permanent auras around you.
Cannot support triggered skills, banner skills or stance skills.

hiddenZh: 弓箭, 攻擊, 輔助, 投射物, 地雷
弓箭,攻擊,輔助,投射物,地雷
輔助使用弓或向前發射投射物的攻擊技能。不是使用該技能，改為投擲地雷當你引爆時使用技能，瞄準你的位置。地雷不能使用引導施放技能。
hiddenEn: Supports attack skills that use bows or wands and fire projectiles ahead. Instead of using that skill, you will throw mines that will use the skill for you when you detonate them, targeting your location. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可冰緩敵人或製造冰緩區域的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that can chill enemies or create chilling areas.

hiddenZh: 冰冷, 火焰, 輔助
輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

hiddenZh: 引導, 法術, 輔助
輔助你自己施展的引導技能，引導時間越久，會大幅強化其傷害，同時增加其消耗。無法修改召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports channelling spells you cast yourself, significantly empowering their damage the longer they are channelled for, while also raising their cost. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 投射物, 輔助, 圖騰
輔助召喚砲塔圖騰的技能。不能調整召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that summon ballista totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 召喚物, 冰冷, 輔助, 法術, 觸發
卓越,召喚物,冰冷,輔助,法術,觸發
輔助由你自身使用的奉獻技能。
hiddenEn: Exceptional, Minion, Cold, Support, Spell, Trigger

hiddenEn: Supports attack skills that can be used with bows. Supported skills can only be used with bows. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

hiddenEn: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能。若普通或魔法怪物在被已輔助技能擊中後低於一定百分比的最大血量，則擊殺他們。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If normal or magic enemies are left below a percentage of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

hiddenZh: 範圍效果, 法術, 輔助

hiddenEn: Supports spell skills that you cast yourself. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, instant skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation or which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

hiddenZh: 輔助非立刻施放的法術技能。

zh: 覺醒．元素攻擊傷害輔助
en: Awakened Elemental Damage with Attacks Support

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中或燃燒敵人，或造成元素異常狀態的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 近戰, 攻擊, 打擊
輔助近戰打擊技能，使近戰攻擊同時多的目標。額外的目標必須要在使用者的最小範圍內。如果輔助召喚物攻擊技能，召喚物的攻擊技能不會攻擊多數目標。不能輔助瓦爾或觸發技能。
hiddenEn: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能，擊中穿透敵人冰冷抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，在投射物前兩次擊中敵人時，使投射物分裂成兩個，且不會穿透。
hiddenEn: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

hiddenZh: 輔助製造召喚物的技能。
輔助影響你和友方的光環技能，增加光環對友方的效果，但光環不再對你產生效果。不能輔助詛咒光環或其他可對敵人造成效果的光環。不能輔助被圖騰使用的技能。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 咒術, 觸發
一定要同時輔助可擊中敵人的技能和咒術技能。技能擊中時會施放咒術。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。
hiddenEn: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能寶石。當此寶石到達 2 等以上，會讓被輔助的寶石套用消耗和保留加成。不能輔助來自非寶石的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

zh: 覺醒．增加範圍效果輔助
en: Awakened Increased Area of Effect Support
hiddenZh: 輔助任何範圍效果的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill with an area of effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能寶石。當此寶石到達 2 等以上，會讓輔助的寶石有額外的品質。不能輔助來自非寶石的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 輔助
輔助近戰攻擊技能，使用時技能重複三次，每次隨機瞄準敵人。不能輔助瓦爾、引導施放、快行、復仇和觸發技能。
hiddenEn: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 引導, 法術, 觸發
一定要同時輔助引導施放和非引導施放技能。引導施放技能在引導時會定期觸發法術技能。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。瓦爾技能、引導時施放技能和保留技能無法被觸發。
hiddenEn: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

hiddenZh: 輔助法術技能，使它們施放時重複施放第二次。不能輔助瓦爾技能、圖騰技能、引導施放技能、觸發技能、立即技能、復仇技能、閃現技能或保留技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

en: Awakened Cast On Critical Strike Support
hiddenZh: 暴擊, 輔助, 法術, 觸發

hiddenEn: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

hiddenEn: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.

輔助近戰攻擊技能。不能輔助觸發型攻擊、用其他東西攻擊而不是你或創造召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何你自己使用擊中敵人的技能。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill you use to hit enemies yourself. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 冰冷, 秘能, 輔助, 法術
卓越,冰冷,秘能,輔助,法術
輔助會造成擊中傷害且沒有保留的法術技能。無法輔助秘能、烙印、球體、瓦爾技能，或由圖騰、陷阱、和地雷使用的技能。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物, 觸發, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 弓箭
輔助,攻擊,投射物,觸發,範圍效果,持續時間,弓箭
輔助攻擊技能，使被輔助的技能在你移動一段距離後，擊中時會觸發風破。不能輔助觸發技能或不是由你使用的技能。無法修改召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, Projectile, Trigger, AoE, Duration, Bow

Supports Attack Skills, causing them to trigger Windburst on hit after you've travelled a certain distance. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 戰吼, 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 物理, 觸發, 近戰
卓越,戰吼,輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,物理,觸發,近戰
輔助由你自身使用的戰吼技能。
hiddenEn: Exceptional, Warcry, Support, Attack, AoE, Physical, Trigger, Melee
Supports warcry skills you use yourself.

hiddenZh: 地雷, 輔助, 範圍效果, 光環
地雷,輔助,範圍效果,光環
輔助法術或使用弓和法杖的攻擊。不再使用技能而是投擲地雷，當你引爆時施放技能。地雷不能使用引導時施放技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a mine that will use the skill for you when you detonate it. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 輔助, 近戰, 攻擊, 打擊
卓越,輔助,近戰,攻擊,打擊
輔助近戰打擊技能，使他們偶爾也會同時打擊額外目標。額外目標需要位於使用者的最小範圍內。若輔助召喚物攻擊技能，該召喚物的技能並不會同時打擊額外目標。無法輔助瓦爾或觸發技能。
hiddenEn: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 輔助, 投射物
輔助投射物技能，使他們的投射物在最初擊中敵人的前兩次未穿透攻擊分裂成兩個。
hiddenEn: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 暴擊, 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發, 攻擊, 持續時間
卓越,暴擊,輔助,範圍效果,觸發,攻擊,持續時間
輔助法杖攻擊，使他們暴擊時有機率觸發力量紊亂。無法輔助觸發技能或是由你以外的來源使用的技能。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Exceptional, Critical, Support, AoE, Trigger, Attack, Duration
Supports Wand Attacks, granting them a chance to trigger Kinetic Flux on critical strike. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 攻擊, 近戰, 輔助
輔助近戰攻擊技能，使他們在使用時重複三次，每一次都會以隨機敵人為目標。無法輔助瓦爾、引導、快行、復仇、或觸發技能。
hiddenEn: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 法術, 範圍效果, 輔助
卓越,法術,範圍效果,輔助
輔助法術技能，使他們在施放時重複。無法輔助瓦爾、圖騰、烙印、引導、觸發、立即、復仇、閃現、或有保留需求的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, brand skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

hiddenZh: 範圍效果, 法術, 卓越, 輔助
範圍效果,法術,卓越,輔助
輔助任何會為目標地點施加範圍效果的法術技能。無法輔助瓦爾技能，或是由圖騰、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 輔助, 連鎖, 投射物
輔助投射物技能，和其他會連鎖的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

hiddenZh: 卓越, 法術, 輔助
輔助法術技能，使他們的效果在施放時重複。無法輔助有冷卻、觸發、烙印、瓦爾、引導、有保留需求的技能，或由圖騰、陷阱、和地雷使用的技能。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助從玩家發射投射物的技能。不會影響從其他位置發射的投射物，作為次要影響。不輔助以螺旋形式發射的投射物。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that fire projectiles from the user. Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. Does not support skills that fire projectiles in a spiral.

hiddenZh: 輔助可擊中敵人的法術。無法影響召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spells that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中敵人的攻擊技能，根據擊中傷害偷取魔力。
hiddenEn: Supports attack skills that hit enemies, causing those hits to leech mana based on damage dealt.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 秘能, 輔助, 法術
輔助可造成擊中傷害和沒有保留的法術技能。不能輔助秘能技能、烙印技能、球體技能、瓦爾技能，或被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用的技能。無法調整召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 弓箭, 輔助, 觸發
輔助弓攻擊技能，當你在其它弓攻擊消耗足夠的魔力時，觸發這些技能。無法影響召喚物技能。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱、地雷、瓦爾技能或引導施放技能。
hiddenEn: Supports bow attack skills, causing them to trigger when you've spent enough mana in total on other bow attacks. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Cannot support totems, traps, mines, Vaal skills, or channelling skills

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 輔助, 召喚物
輔助製造召喚物的技能。
火焰, 輔助, 範圍效果
輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助從玩家發射投射物的技能。不會影響從其他位置發射的投射物，作為次要影響。不輔助以螺旋形式發射的投射物。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that fire projectiles from the user. Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. Does not support skills that fire projectiles in a spiral.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 火焰, 冰冷, 閃電, 範圍效果, 弓箭
攻擊,投射物,火焰,冰冷,閃電,範圍效果,弓箭
使用法杖或弓射出一個投射物，造成火焰、冰冷與閃電傷害。投射物擊中敵人時會對周圍的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, Projectile, Fire, Cold, Lightning, AoE, Bow
Fires a projectile with a wand or bow that deals fire, cold and lightning damage. If the projectile hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 持續時間, 閃電, 連鎖
攻擊,近戰,打擊,持續時間,閃電,連鎖
使用近戰武器攻擊，若有擊中目標則獲得一層持續一段時間的電光凝聚增益效果。當你有電光凝聚時，使用此技能攻擊將產生能夠連鎖的電光，並根據電光凝聚的層數提高連鎖次數。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Duration, Lightning, Chaining

Attack with a melee weapon, gaining a Gathering Lightning buff for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have Gathering Lightning, attacks with this skill will cause chaining beams of lightning, which chain additional times the more Gathering Lightning you have.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷
陷阱,法術,範圍效果,冰冷
投擲一個陷阱，當觸發時在自身附近形成一連串冰冷的符文爆炸，對所有被爆炸困住的敵人造成冰冷傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions in a circle around itself when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 物理
法術,範圍效果,冰冷,物理
冰柱從地面接連浮現小爆炸，對範圍內敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 冰冷
聚集空氣中的水分，製造一堵能阻擋敵人行動的冰牆。在冰牆成形位置的敵人將會受到傷害並且被擊退，同時存在的冰牆越多，造成的傷害就越高。
hiddenEn: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back, with more damage dealt the more frost walls are currently active.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 冰冷
發射在撞擊地面或敵人時會裂化的冰之碎片。在裂化後投射物轉化為第二型態，此階段碎片飛行速度更快且能穿透敵人。
hiddenEn: Launches a shard of ice that splits on hitting terrain or enemies. After splitting, the projectiles are in second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

hiddenZh: 地雷, 暴擊, 法術, 投射物, 冰冷, 光環, 範圍效果
地雷,暴擊,法術,投射物,冰冷,光環,範圍效果
投擲一個地雷，引爆後朝敵人發射投射物。這些投射物隨著飛行快速消逝。
hiddenEn: Mine, Critical, Spell, Projectile, Cold, Aura, AoE
Throws a mine that fires projectiles at enemies when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

hiddenZh: 地雷, 暴擊, 法術, 投射物, 冰冷, 光環, 範圍效果
地雷,暴擊,法術,投射物,冰冷,光環,範圍效果
投擲一個地雷，引爆後朝周圍發射投射物。這些投射物隨著飛行快速消逝。
hiddenEn: Mine, Critical, Spell, Projectile, Cold, Aura, AoE
Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 冰冷, 範圍效果, 持續時間
攻擊,近戰,打擊,冰冷,範圍效果,持續時間
大幅增加攻擊範圍，若擊中製造冰緩區域造成冰冷持續傷害。限定近戰武器。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Cold, AoE, Duration
Attack enemies with greatly increased range, creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time if it hits. Requires a Melee Weapon.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 冰冷
暴擊,攻擊,近戰,打擊,冰冷
擊中敵人，轉換一部分的物理傷害為冰冷傷害。若連續打擊 3 次，第 3 下則更容易冰凍敵人。限定錘、權杖或長杖。
hiddenEn: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will be a critical strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 弓箭
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,冰冷,弓箭
發射一支能將部分物理傷害轉為冰冷傷害的穿刺箭，並將目標正反兩面扇形範圍的所有物理傷害轉為冰冷傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires a piercing arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in two cones perpendicular to the target.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 新星
法術,範圍效果,冰冷,新星
一個冰冷之環在施法者四周膨脹。如果施法目標區域附近存在著寒冰彈，則冰冷之環將在寒冰彈的四周膨脹。若此技能以此方式重複施放，則會在同一個投射物再次使冰冷之環膨脹。
hiddenEn: A circle of ice expands from the caster. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will expand from a number of those projectiles instead. If this skill would repeat when cast this way, it will instead expand again from the same projectiles after a short delay.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 新星
法術,範圍效果,冰冷,新星
一個冰冷之環在施法者四周膨脹。
hiddenEn: A circle of ice expands from the caster.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 冰冷
發射單一眼睛投射物，不能對敵人造成傷害。當眼睛消逝或撞擊地面，它會釋放快速螺旋的碎片。碎片會對撞擊的敵人造成冰冷傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 冰冷
發射單一眼睛投射物，在消逝前釋放數個螺旋投射物。碎片會對撞擊的敵人造成冰冷傷害。眼睛不能對敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 引導, 近戰
暴擊,攻擊,範圍效果,引導,近戰
引導施放時重複地攻擊你前方的敵人，對敵人和附近造成傷害。在引導時，暴擊率不斷提高。一旦引導結束，你會釋放每個階段所達到的額外打擊。
hiddenEn: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The critical strike chance is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 持續時間
陷阱,攻擊,範圍效果,持續時間
投擲一個陷阱，一旦觸發，陷阱會在附近旋轉兩把你裝備的雙手劍的複製體，每次旋轉都會對穿過的敵人造成重複傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Two Handed Sword around it in circles for a duration, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 物理
陷阱,攻擊,範圍效果,物理
投擲一個陷阱，一旦觸發，就會將你裝備的匕首、爪、單手劍或單手斧的兩個複製體圍繞它旋轉成一個圓圈，每個複製體都會對旋轉穿過的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw, One Handed Sword or One Handed Axe around it in a circle, each damaging enemies it spins through.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰
角色以弧狀揮動兩把武器，對前方範圍怪物造成傷害。限定雙持斧和劍。
hiddenEn: The character swings both their weapons in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Requires dual wielding both an Axe and a Sword.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 新星
法術,範圍效果,物理,新星
對你附近區域造成法術傷害。你裝備中的匕首附加至此傷害。
hiddenEn: Deals spell damage in an area around you. Your equipped daggers add to this damage.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 新星
法術,範圍效果,物理,新星
對你附近區域造成法術傷害。若你有飛刃風暴圍繞你，它將依次引爆，每個對你附近區域再次造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Deals spell damage in an area around you. If you have Blade Vortex blades orbiting you, it will detonate each of them in turn, dealing damage again in an area around you for each one.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 閃電
揮動你的法杖附近敵人發射一個投射物；若是擊中的目標被擊殺或是短時間內被擊殺，將會為產生一顆暴擊球。
hiddenEn: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 物理
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,物理
從法杖中射出一個投射物，在接觸到物體或敵人時對周圍二段範圍連續爆破造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 持續時間, 範圍效果
攻擊,投射物,持續時間,範圍效果
揮動你的法杖來創造多個懸浮投射物。經過短暫的持續時間後，投射物會引爆並造成範圍傷害。再次使用此攻擊將會重置所有懸浮投射物的持續時間。此技能不能直接被陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Wave your wand to create multiple hovering kinetic projectiles. After a short duration, the projectiles explode, dealing area damage. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.

hiddenZh: 從你的法杖發射一個投射物，該投射物以規律或擊中敵人時，以 Z 字型改變方向。每次改變方向，二階段投射物會爆開，並朝另一個方向飛去。這些投射物可以擊中同個目標多次。
hiddenEn: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. Multiple of these projectiles can hit the same target.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物
揮舞你的法杖，使複數投射物在你前方的大片區域灑落， 並且鎖定區域內的敵人位置。 投射物掉落的位置會在落下前預先標記。 每一個掉落的投射物都會在落地時爆炸，造成範圍傷害。
hiddenEn: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage.

hiddenZh: 召喚一個會使用許多揮擊範圍攻擊的奪魂鐮。奪魂鐮存在時會弱化你其它非奪魂鐮召喚物，奪魂鐮會吞噬它們來短暫強化和治癒奪魂鐮。
hiddenEn: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves.

hiddenZh: 物理, 召喚物, 法術
召喚一個強大的奪魂鐮跟隨你，但不會攻擊敵人。奪魂鐮存在時會弱化你其它的召喚物，並會吞噬它們來短暫強化和治癒奪魂鐮。當已召喚奪魂鐮時使用此技能，會使它衝向指定位置，並使用強力攻擊。不能被觸發，被施放迴響或釋放輔助，或被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 冰冷, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚寒冰魔像。寒冰魔像會施放寒冰彈幕並在近戰攻擊時附加額外的冰旋斬。若魔像生命到達貧血時，會觸發自毀法術，造成範圍傷害並發射環形冰冷投射物。
hiddenEn: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. If reduced to low life it will trigger a spell that destroys itself to deal area damage and fire icy projectiles in a circle.

hiddenZh: 冰冷, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚寒冰魔像。寒冰魔像會施放寒冰彈幕並在近戰攻擊時附加額外的冰旋斬。
hiddenEn: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 法術, 魔像, 物理
召喚一個巨石魔像，它將承受你從敵人攻擊中受到的部分近戰傷害，以減少你的損傷。除了它的近戰攻擊外，巨石魔像還使用滾動衝刺和強力猛擊，可以嘲諷敵人。
hiddenEn: Summons a Stone Golem that takes a portion of the melee damage you recieve from enemy hits from its life before yours. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 法術, 魔像, 物理
召喚一個巨石魔像。除了一般的近戰攻擊外，巨石魔像會使用滾動衝撞，還有沉重的衝擊波來嘲諷附近的敵人。
hiddenEn: Summons a Stone Golem. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間, 火焰
法術,召喚物,持續時間,火焰
召喚只能存在極短時間的憤怒狂靈，這些火焰骷髏將會衝至敵人身邊並快速的進行攻擊，全部物理傷害轉化至火焰。敵方生物將不會主動攻擊這些狂靈，並可以穿越它們。
hiddenEn: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

en: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelström
hiddenZh: 混沌, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚混沌魔像。混沌魔像施放強大的持續傷害的混沌光環，並在近戰攻擊附加凋零。
hiddenEn: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a powerful damage over time Chaos aura that Withers enemies in addition to its melee attack.

hiddenZh: 混沌, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚混沌魔像。混沌魔像會施放一個造成持續傷害的混沌光環並在近戰攻擊附加額外的混沌之刺。
hiddenEn: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

hiddenZh: 火焰, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚烈焰魔像。烈焰魔像會使用火焰放射，持續造成火焰傷害，及射出會爆炸的弧狀移動投射物。
hiddenEn: Summons a Flame Golem. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.

en: Summon Flame Golem of the Meteor
hiddenZh: 火焰, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚烈焰魔像。召喚時，烈焰魔像從天空墜落進行攻擊，在區域內造成火焰傷害，並在影響範圍附近留下燃燒地面。落地後，它還可以施放火焰噴射和一波火焰傷害。
hiddenEn: Summons a Flame Golem. When summoned, the Flame Golem attacks by falling from the sky, dealing fire damage in an area and leaving burning ground around the impact. After landing, it can cast a fire spray and a wave of fire damage.

hiddenZh: 召喚一個聖物待在你附近。當你的攻擊擊中敵人，聖物會釋放一個有短冷卻時間的星形法術，對附近一名敵人周圍區域內的敵人造成物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies in an area around a nearby enemy.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚一個閃電魔像。魔像會對敵人發射投射物法術、製造會殘喘附近敵人的電球、並施放一個暫時的光環讓魔像和附近的友方附加閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

hiddenZh: 物理, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚一個食腐魔像。腐魔像會施展連續攻擊且越來越快越來越痛，可以消耗屍體治癒自己，並釋放毀滅性的骨刺爆發，並根據它附近每個非魔像召喚物造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, can consume corpses to heal itself and gain the ability to unleash a devastating cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

hiddenZh: 物理, 召喚物, 法術, 魔像
召喚一個食腐魔像。腐魔像會施展連續攻擊且越來越快越來越痛，同時會有骨刺爆發。
hiddenEn: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間, 三相
法術,召喚物,持續時間,三相
在指定位置召喚隨機元素類型的骷髏法師。它們會根據自己的元素施放投射物法術，並在一段時間後死亡。
hiddenEn: Summon Skeleton Mage minions of random elemental types at the targeted location. They cast projectile spells based on their element, and die after a duration.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間
在指定位置召喚骷髏弓箭手。它們會發射箭矢並在一段時間後死亡。
hiddenEn: Summon Skeleton Archer minions at the targeted location. They fire arrows and die after a duration.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 混沌, 咒術
法術,範圍效果,混沌,咒術
對單一敵人造成混沌傷害。若敵人被咒術，會對目標附近敵人造成範圍傷害。
hiddenEn: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 混沌, 咒術
法術,範圍效果,混沌,咒術
對單一敵人造成混沌傷害，若敵人被咒術則造成更多傷害，並移除咒術。若敵人被咒術，會對目標附近敵人造成範圍傷害，同樣以此方式，從這些敵人的加成效果和移除咒術。
hiddenEn: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間
唱名喚魂，從目標屍體喚醒其幽魂並使役它為你而戰一小段時間。
hiddenEn: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a temporary minion to fight for you in battle for a duration.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 火焰
陷阱,法術,持續時間,範圍效果,火焰
投擲一個陷阱，觸發後會向不同方位釋放火焰。火焰會持續一段時間，並持續造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration repeatedly dealing damage.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 範圍效果, 物理
陷阱,法術,範圍效果,物理
投擲一個陷阱，一旦被觸發會釋放多個衝擊波。每個衝擊波對線上造成一連串小爆炸，最終造成大爆炸。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap which, once triggered, releases a number of waves. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
重擊地面造成一波翻騰的地形，對你前方的一連串區域造成傷害。被波浪擊中的敵人中的一些將釋放一個震波，對其附近的其他敵人造成傷害。限定錘、權杖、斧、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Slams the ground, creating a wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 混沌, 弓箭
發射會在軌道留下黴孢的的箭矢。黴孢會爆裂，發射荊棘箭矢，在飛行一小段時間就會消逝。發射額外投射物詞綴只會影響初始的箭矢，每到軌跡都會留下黴孢。
hiddenEn: Fire an arrow that leaves a spore pod in its wake. The spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, each of which leaves its own spore pod.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 範圍效果, 閃電
法術,投射物,範圍效果,閃電
以螺旋形式發射一個投射物，對區域內的每個敵人持續雷擊造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 球體
法術,範圍效果,閃電,球體
在指定區域製造天雷之珠，對區域內的每個敵人反覆雷擊造成傷害。無法以施放迴響輔助或讓圖騰使用。
hiddenEn: Creates a ball of lightning at a location that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Cannot be supported by Spell Echo or used by Totems.

hiddenZh: 火焰, 近戰, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 位移, 持續時間, 重擊
火焰,近戰,攻擊,範圍效果,位移,持續時間,重擊
重擊目標位置地面。如果目標位置附近有敵人，你會在重擊前傳送一小段距離至該位置，並額外製造奉獻地面。可以消耗耐力球無視冷卻時間。不能被多重打擊輔助。限定劍、斧、錘、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Fire, Melee, Attack, AoE, Movement, Duration, Slam

Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 朝你面前的數個敵人拋出魚竿。遠方的非傳奇敵人會被拉向你。
hiddenEn: Cast your fishing rod towards a number of enemies in front of you. Non-unique enemies far away from you are pulled towards you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 冰冷, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,冰冷,重擊
猛擊地面，對附近區域的敵人造成傷害。使用主手武器進行的打擊造成更多傷害。使用副手武器進行的打擊具有更大的範圍效果。限定雙持劍、錘、全杖或斧。
hiddenEn: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area. Slams with main hand weapon deal more damage. Slams with off hand weapon have larger area of effect. Requires dual-wielding Swords, Maces, Sceptres, or Axes to use.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 冰冷
法術,投射物,持續時間,範圍效果,冰冷
射出一個寒冰投射物，在接觸到敵人或到達目標區域時會爆炸，造成範圍傷害和製造會造成冰冷持續傷害的冰緩區域。此冰緩區域會迅速蔓延至附近的敵人，直到它的持續時間結束。
hiddenEn: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 冰冷
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,冰冷
製造一個持續一段時間的水晶。當水晶的持續時間結束時，它爆炸，對附近的敵人造成冰冷傷害。
hiddenEn: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing cold damage to enemies around it.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 冰冷
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,冰冷
製造一個持續一段時間的水晶。當水晶的持續時間結束時，它爆炸，對附近的敵人造成大量冰冷傷害。
hiddenEn: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電
雷擊目標位置附近的多名敵人。不能被秘能爆發輔助。
hiddenEn: Lightning strikes a number of enemies around a targeted location. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

hiddenZh: 位移, 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 快行, 召喚物
位移,法術,範圍效果,火焰,快行,召喚物
你的身體和目標屍體爆炸造成附近範圍法術傷害，你的身體會在屍體或可傷害的召喚物位置重建。若沒有指定目標，將會優先選取可傷害的召喚物，而不是屍體。若指定召喚物，召喚物會被爆炸摧毀，對附近造成傷害，此爆炸不受法術傷害詞綴影響且不能被反射。此法術無法被重複。
hiddenEn: Movement, Spell, AoE, Fire, Travel, Minion

Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or damageable minion, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise minions over enemies. If targeting a minion, the minion will also be destroyed in an explosion which deals damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰
指定屍體使之爆炸造成火焰傷害。此爆炸不獸法術傷害詞綴影響且不能被反射。不能指定被技能製造的屍體。
hiddenEn: Targets a corpse, causing it to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. Cannot target corpses that have been created by skills.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰
指定屍體並對附近敵人造成法術傷害，同時引爆屍體造成火焰傷害。屍體爆炸不受法術傷害屬性影響，也無法被反射。此會在短時間內持續指定區域內其他屍體，直到消耗完畢屍體或摧毀 8 個屍體。不能被秘能爆發輔助。
hiddenEn: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with a shorter delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 8 corpses. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 閃電
幻化一個近戰武器或護甲，並附加到隱形守護者身上，讓它使用雷鳴重擊．聖判，且無視武器限制來與你並肩作戰。幻化的多件物品都會附加到同一個守護者身上。你無法幻化未鑑定的物品。無法被陷阱或地雷使用。若守護者陣亡，你無法在該區域再次召喚幻化守護者。
hiddenEn: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side using Smite of Divine Judgement, ignoring weapon restrictions. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.

hiddenZh: 持續時間, 召喚物, 法術
幻化你主手近戰武器的複製體來為你而戰。不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Animates a copy of your main hand Melee Weapon to fight by your side. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps or Mines.

hiddenZh: 持續時間, 召喚物, 法術, 物理
持續時間,召喚物,法術,物理
幻化一把遠程武器或剩餘的劍刃來為你而戰。但是不能幻化未鑑定的武器。不會幻化 6 洞武器，除非有特別指定。不能被陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Animates a Ranged Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 弓箭
在短暫的準備之後，使用弓或法杖重複發射投射物。這些投射物會稍微隨機散射。此技能不能被觸發。
hiddenEn: After a short preparation time, you fire projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 圖騰, 物理, 弓箭
攻擊,投射物,圖騰,物理,弓箭
召喚一個砲塔，消耗你的鋼鐵碎片來發射強力的多重箭矢，並將箭矢粉碎至碎片。敵人可以被同個多重箭矢擊中多次。限定弓。鋼鐵碎片透過鋼之呼喚技能獲得。
hiddenEn: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,火焰,持續時間
釋放怒焰之力對前方敵人進行攻擊。若此點燃敵人，會在它們下方製造大範圍的燃燒地面。你的傷害詞綴不會影響此燃燒地面。
hiddenEn: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. If this ignites an enemy a large area of burning ground will be created under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

hiddenZh: 法術, 冰冷, 攻擊, 近戰, 範圍效果
法術,冰冷,攻擊,近戰,範圍效果
此法術消耗多個冷卻使用次數以環形方式召喚冰凍雕像。每個雕像在消失前都會使用一次橫掃．凍結。限定斧、錘、權杖或長杖。此技能不能被觸發、被施放迴響或釋放輔助、被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 法術, 連鎖, 物理, 持續時間
法術,連鎖,物理,持續時間
從你的角色釋放一條血之射線，將瞄準你面前的敵人，然後連鎖到其他敵人。這條血之射線造成物理傷害並給敵人造成一個物理持續傷害減益效果，可以堆疊最多3次。
hiddenEn: Releases a tendril of blood from your character, which will target an enemy in front of you, then chain to other enemies. The tendril deals physical damage and inflicts a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間, 物理
陷阱,法術,持續時間,物理
投擲一個陷阱，觸發該陷阱的敵人將會受到傷害並穿刺，且根據傷害被固定在原地一段時間。法術傷害詞綴無法影響此技能傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that damages and impales a single enemy, and immobilises them for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.

hiddenZh: 法術, 物理, 範圍效果, 持續時間
法術,物理,範圍效果,持續時間
一把血腥鐮刀橫掃你周遭的區域，對敵人造成物理傷害和物理持續傷害減益效果。若敵人存活，你會獲得 1 顆血腥球，會增加技能傷害和消耗。玩家最多有 5 顆血腥球。
hiddenEn: A bloody scythe swipes around you, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 圖騰, 弓箭
召喚一座砲塔，使用穿透箭矢攻擊。限定弓。
hiddenEn: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with forking arrows.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 範圍效果, 持續時間
攻擊,近戰,範圍效果,持續時間
進行旋轉攻擊，攻擊你附近的敵人並製造一個隨機的劍刃風暴。劍刃風暴持續傷害敵人一段時間，根據你的武器傷害和攻擊時間。血腥旋天劍舞是靜止並且會造成流血，沙戮旋天劍舞則會向前緩慢移動並致盲敵人。限定劍和斧。
hiddenEn: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a random bladestorm. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 位移, 引導
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,位移,引導
引導施放此技能，邊旋轉邊向目標地點路徑上的敵人攻擊。當引導施放此技能時，你不會被擊退。
hiddenEn: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 閃電, 投射物, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,閃電,投射物,弓箭
向空中發射一支箭矢，落在目標位置，造成範圍傷害。箭矢會插入落地的地面上，並持續地向你發射一道閃電，在你和箭矢之間造成範圍傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to you, dealing area damage between the arrow and you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 閃電, 投射物, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,閃電,投射物,弓箭
向空中發射一支箭矢，落在目標位置，造成範圍傷害。箭矢會插入落地的地面上，並持續地向它附近的另一支箭矢發射一道閃電，在它們之間造成範圍傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 持續時間, 烙印
法術,範圍效果,火焰,持續時間,烙印
製造一個可以附著於附近敵人的魔法烙印。當附著時，會定期發動從天上落下熾炎的流星。當敵人死亡時烙印會掉落。
hiddenEn: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 持續時間, 烙印
法術,範圍效果,火焰,持續時間,烙印
製造一個可以附著於附近敵人的魔法烙印。它只會啟動一次，使天上落下熾炎的流星後被摧毀。
hiddenEn: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰
以魔法之火快速的燃燒自己及周圍的敵人。在此效果下，你的施放速度大幅增加。當你的生命只剩下 1 時將會自動停止此法術。需要魔力。
hiddenEn: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your cast speed is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining. Requires mana.

hiddenZh: 將死靈能量召喚至目標上空，之後轉化為殭屍。殭屍會砸落地面，以衝擊波造成範圍傷害。殭屍無法在衝擊中倖存。
hiddenEn: Raises necromantic energies into the sky above a targeted location, where they coalesce into a zombie minion. The minion then attacks by falling to the ground, causing an impact that deals damage in an area. The zombie cannot survive the impact.

hiddenZh: 從一個屍體中復甦一隻殭屍，它會跟隨你並使用近戰打擊和範圍重擊攻擊敵人。
hiddenEn: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike and an area of effect slam.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 混沌, 投射物, 連鎖
攻擊,範圍效果,混沌,投射物,連鎖
投擲1個落地時會爆炸的瓶子，在特定區域內造成空手攻擊傷害，並有機率施加中毒。此技能會隨機彈跳造成多次傷害。消耗生命藥劑的飲用次數可以增加更多傷害。限定空手，且不能持有副手武器。
hiddenEn: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 持續時間, 近戰, 打擊, 混沌
攻擊,持續時間,近戰,打擊,混沌
對敵人進行攻擊，轉化你部分的物理傷害為混沌傷害並造成中毒，該中毒受到技能持續時間影響。雙持時，會在一次打擊造成兩把武器的傷害。限定爪、匕首與劍。
hiddenEn: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, deals the damage of both weapons in one strike. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.

hiddenZh: 火焰, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理
火焰,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,物理
一道神聖火焰對直線上造成傷害，並製造奉獻地面，對目標地區週圍也造成傷害。之後會有波較大的衝擊波向外擴散，對站在奉獻地面上且未被擊中的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 持續時間, 新星
法術,範圍效果,冰冷,持續時間,新星
一個會在施法者周圍爆炸的冰爆，對敵人造成冰冷傷害，並留下一個漩渦，對於在其中的敵人繼續造成持續冰冷傷害和冰緩。若施法目標區域附近有寒冰彈，冰爆則會出現在寒冰彈的位置，並摧毀它們。
hiddenEn: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will explode from a number of those projectiles instead, destroying them.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 火焰
陷阱,法術,持續時間,範圍效果,火焰
投擲一個陷阱，該陷阱被觸發時會爆炸並對附近的敵人造成火焰傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 圖騰, 範圍效果, 火焰, 投射物, 弓箭
攻擊,圖騰,範圍效果,火焰,投射物,弓箭
召喚一個砲塔圖騰，瘋狂的對空中發射箭矢。箭矢對直線地面造成影響，每個都對靠近它的敵人造成傷害。限定弓。
hiddenEn: Attack, Totem, AoE, Fire, Projectile, Bow
Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 圖騰, 範圍效果, 火焰, 投射物, 弓箭
攻擊,圖騰,範圍效果,火焰,投射物,弓箭
召喚一個砲塔圖騰，瘋狂的對空中發射箭矢。箭矢對直線地面造成影響，每個都對靠近它的敵人造成傷害。限定弓。
hiddenEn: Attack, Totem, AoE, Fire, Projectile, Bow
Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow.

hiddenZh: 法術, 圖騰, 火焰, 範圍效果, 持續時間
法術,圖騰,火焰,範圍效果,持續時間
召喚一個會圖騰，它會對你和你所操控的所有圖騰之間施放一道光束，對被光束觸碰到的敵人造成燃燒傷害。靠近光束兩側尾端的敵人將會受到燃燒傷害。在達到最大啟用圖騰數量時會引爆所有來自此技能的圖騰，施加同樣的燃燒傷害，持續一段時間。
