hiddenEn: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. Reaching maximum active totem count will cause all totems from this skill to detonate, applying the same burning damage for a duration.

hiddenZh: 混沌, 觸發, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 咒術
混沌,觸發,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,咒術
對小範圍內敵人造成一個造成混沌持續傷害的減益效果，同時串聯的咒術詛咒也會對範圍敵人造成影響。每個以此方式造成的咒術，使減益效果造成更多持續傷害持續更久。此技能不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Chaos, Trigger, Spell, AoE, Duration, Hex

Applies a debuff to enemies in a small area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 近戰, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 重擊, 火焰
近戰,攻擊,範圍效果,重擊,火焰
猛擊地面，製造一道曲折的裂縫，在向外蔓延時造成範圍傷害。當它到達目標位置時會爆發，造成範圍傷害。在爆發後，裂縫持續向敵人蔓延，造成進一步的爆發。限定斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts dealing damage in an area. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 地雷, 法術, 投射物, 火焰, 範圍效果, 光環, 新星
地雷,法術,投射物,火焰,範圍效果,光環,新星
投擲一顆地雷，當它被引爆時會造成範圍傷害，然後發射火熱的彈射物，落在附近區域，每個投射物會爆炸並造成更小範圍的傷害。已放置的地雷會向周遭敵人施加火焰曝曬。
hiddenEn: Mine, Spell, Projectile, Fire, AoE, Aura, Nova

Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 火焰
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,火焰
呼喚無數火焰之球如雨一般灑落在目標區域。每顆火球落地時將會爆炸，並對附近的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰
一個巨大火焰之球朝目標區域砸落。每顆火球落地時將會爆炸，並對附近的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: A large flaming bolt falls towards the targeted area. The bolt explodes when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 引導
法術,範圍效果,火焰,引導
引導施放緊縮爆炸，當停止使用技能時釋放。引導持續時間越長，爆炸傷害更大，但更小的範圍。
hiddenEn: Channels to concentrate an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the damage of the explosion, but the smaller the area.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 引導
法術,範圍效果,火焰,引導
引導施放累積爆炸，當停止使用技能或自動到最大疊層時釋放。引導持續時間越長，範圍效果和爆炸傷害越大。
hiddenEn: Channels to build up an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill or automatically at maximum stages. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.

hiddenZh: 法術, 位移, 持續時間, 火焰
法術,位移,持續時間,火焰
傳送到指定地點，對敵人造成傷害並在路線上造成燃燒地面，然後重複傳送至其他方位。不能被觸發，或被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。不能被釋放輔助。
hiddenEn: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground, then repeat the teleport in the other direction. Cannot be triggered, or used by a totem, trap or mine. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊, 火焰, 持續時間
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊,火焰,持續時間
使用你的武器攻擊，對你使用此技能擊中的第一個敵人產生一個充能的減益效果。當充能減益效果消逝或累積6層充能時，效果將被移除並對該敵人和附近敵人造成傷害。限定劍、斧、錘、權杖、長杖或是空手。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Strike, Fire, Duration

Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to you the first time you hit an enemy with this skill. Upon reaching 6 charges, or charges expiring, the charged debuff is removed to damage nearby enemies. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊, 火焰
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,近戰,打擊,火焰
為你的雙手武器注入熔岩之力，使你的攻擊帶有物理和火焰傷害。此攻擊使熔岩球向你擊中敵人的前方發射，在被打擊擊中的所有敵人之間彈跳。熔岩球在他們落地時，對敵人造成範圍攻擊傷害。使用此技能每 5 次攻擊會發射更高傷害的投射物。
hiddenEn: Attack, Projectile, AoE, Melee, Strike, Fire

Infuses your two-handed melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land. Every fifth time you attack with this skill it fires more, high-damage projectiles.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 持續時間, 投射物, 球體
法術,範圍效果,火焰,持續時間,投射物,球體
指定的屍體爆炸，造成範圍傷害並變成火山噴泉，在一段時間內會連續釋放爆炸性的投射物來攻擊附近的區域，並引爆附近的屍體。屍體爆炸不受法術傷害詞綴影響，並且不會被反射。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Fire, Duration, Projectile, Orb

A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area and detonate nearby corpses for a duration. Corpse explosions are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 持續時間, 投射物, 球體
法術,範圍效果,火焰,持續時間,投射物,球體
製造火山噴泉，在一段時間內會連續釋放爆炸性的投射物來攻擊附近的區域。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Fire, Duration, Projectile, Orb
Creates a volcanic geyser at a location, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration.

hiddenZh: 法術, 火焰, 持續時間, 引導
法術,火焰,持續時間,引導
釋放一道灼熱的火焰光束，燃燒它觸及的敵人。留在光束中會提高燃燒效果，分階段增加光束傷害的一部分。離開光束的敵人在一段時間內仍然會持續燃燒。增加施放速度同時增加光束旋轉速度。
hiddenEn: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 火焰, 弓箭
發射一支燃燒箭矢並造成火焰傷害並有機率造成點燃。
hiddenEn: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

hiddenZh: 法術, 火焰, 引導, 範圍效果
法術,火焰,引導,範圍效果
持續從手中散發出火焰之柱，持續對敵人造成傷害。你引導施放此技能越久，火焰會在你面前擴散更廣更遠。當你停止引導施放時，你釋放出一個緩慢移動的火焰傷害波，覆蓋一個非常大的區域，並造成強大的點燃。
hiddenEn: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a slow-moving wave of fire damage over a very large area that will apply a powerful Ignite.

hiddenZh: 法術, 火焰, 引導, 範圍效果
法術,火焰,引導,範圍效果
持續從手中散發出火焰之柱，持續對敵人造成傷害。你引導施放此技能越久，火焰會在你面前擴散更廣更遠。
hiddenEn: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 火焰, 冰冷, 閃電, 投射物
暴擊,攻擊,範圍效果,火焰,冰冷,閃電,投射物
投擲一個爆炸瓶，對範圍內造成空手攻擊傷害。可以消耗你的紅玉、藍玉和黃玉藥劑的充能來增加額外的傷害。限定空手，且沒有副手武器。
hiddenEn: Critical, Attack, AoE, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Projectile

Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 物理
陷阱,法術,範圍效果,火焰,物理
投擲一個觸發時會造成爆炸的陷阱，造成範圍法術傷害。緊跟在第一次爆炸後，數個小爆炸在陷阱周圍的次要區域內接連發生。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 範圍效果, 物理
陷阱,法術,範圍效果,物理
投擲一個觸發時會造成大爆炸的陷阱，造成範圍法術傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that creates a large explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理, 火焰, 新星
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,物理,火焰,新星
向你前方的環形範圍發送一股滾動的能量一段時間，對敵人造成傷害。隨後環形返回，在回程途中再次對敵人造成傷害。同一時間只能發動一次信念浪湧。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Duration, Physical, Fire, Nova

An expanding wave of energy surges outwards from you, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration. The ring then returns, damaging enemies again on the way back. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
重擊地面，產生一道移動的震盪波，對你前方的敵人依序造成傷害。震盪波擊中敵人後釋放出震波，對周圍其他敵人造成傷害。再次使用此技能將使前一震盪波停止行進。震盪波遭遇目標或地形時，如果範圍中有敵人，則會重新導向到其身上。需要裝備錘、權杖、斧、長杖，或是空手。
hiddenEn: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. When the wave reaches a target or terrain, it can restart aiming towards an enemy, if one is in range. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰
朝你前方投擲鎖鏈，使其附著在擊中的目標身上。擊中被鍊住的敵人會賦予盛怒。當鎖鏈破碎時，它們會斷開並對其附著目標周圍的一片區域造成攻擊傷害。需要單手錘、權杖、劍或斧。
hiddenEn: Throws chains ahead of you, attaching them to targets hit. Enemies chained to you will grant rage when hit. When chains are broken, they snap and deal attack damage in an area around the target they were attached to. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 圖騰, 弓箭
在目標區域周圍召喚一道砲塔圖騰環。這些砲塔對目標區域開火一次後消失。需要裝備弓。
hiddenEn: Summons a ring of ballista totems around a targeted location. These ballistae fire once at the targeted location and then expire. Requires a Bow.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 混沌, 新星
法術,範圍效果,混沌,新星
這個法術會對你周遭範圍造成混沌傷害。施放這個法術會讓你獲得毀滅。如果這個法術對你造成第七層毀滅，就會獻祭你的大量生命，根據獻祭的生命來造成額外混沌傷害，並移除你身上的所有毀滅。
hiddenEn: This spell deals chaos damage in an area around you. Casting this spell will cause you to gain Ruin. If this spell inflicts your seventh Ruin, it will sacrifice a large portion of your life to deal extra chaos damage based on the amount sacrificed, and remove all Ruin from you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
以強力揮擊攻擊敵人。需要長杖。
hiddenEn: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Staff.

hiddenZh: 火焰, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 持續時間, 弓箭
火焰,攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,持續時間,弓箭
對天空射出一支箭矢，降落於目標位置。箭矢對落地區域附近造成範圍傷害，並釋放出一道炎浪，對敵人造成燃燒減益效果。箭矢的衝擊也會施加這個減益效果。
hiddenEn: Fire, Attack, AoE, Projectile, Duration, Bow

Fires a single arrow up in the air, to rain down at a targeted location. The arrow deals area damage around where it lands, as well as releasing a wave of fire which will apply a burning debuff to enemies. The impact of the arrow will also inflict this debuff.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 物理
投擲出你盾牌的靈體複製品，使其成為穿透性投射物，造成副手傷害並受盾牌防禦增幅。其抵達目標位置時會滯空，不斷朝所有方向發射多個小型碎片投射物。其釋出碎片的速度會增加，直到所有碎片都射出。額外射出投射物的詞綴會附加更多碎片，但不會產生更多盾牌複製品。
hiddenEn: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a piercing projectile which deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it reaches the targeted location it will hover in place, repeatedly firing a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. The rate at which it releases shards will increase until all shards have been fired. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 秘能, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,物理,秘能,持續時間
發動後會持續消耗魔力，從空中召下一連串虛空幻影武器落在你身邊，對衝擊到的敵人造成傷害。在可能的情況下，每把刀刃會鎖定齊射範圍中的不同敵人。就算有多把刀刃落在身上，每個敵人在每次齊射中只能被擊中一次。這個技能不會被圖騰、陷阱或地雷觸發或使用。
hiddenEn: Once activated, continuously spends mana to cause volleys of ethereal weapons rain from the sky around you, dealing damage to enemies they impact. Each Blade will target a separate enemy in the volley area if possible. Each enemy can only be hit once by each volley, even if multiple blades land near them. This skill cannot be triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 攻擊, 投射物
投擲一個陷阱，在觸發時會射出多個你近戰武器的幽魂複製體。它們會四散射出，接著返回到陷阱觸發的位置，路徑上會以迴旋攻擊對敵人造成傷害。若雙持，每個投出的陷阱會隨機以主手或副手武器攻擊。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires many spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out in all directions and then return to where the trap triggered, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 攻擊, 投射物
投擲一個陷阱，一旦觸發，就會發射你近戰武器的幽魂複製體。它會在大範圍內迴旋飛行，對路徑上的敵人造成傷害，撞到牆壁後還會彈開。若雙持，每個投出的陷阱會隨機使用主手或副手武器。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,物理
在一個位置設置一個標記。經過短暫時間後，標記會遭一發閃電擊中，對其周圍造成物理傷害，並使閃電擊向你施放的任何其他標記。閃電衝擊會留下一攤沸騰之血，在第二段持續時間內對其中的敵人造成物理持續傷害。
hiddenEn: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, a bolt strikes the marker, dealing physical damage around it and causing bolts to strike at any other markers you've cast. Bolt impacts will leave behind a pool of boiling blood, which deals physical damage over time to enemies within it for a secondary duration.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
使用近戰武器進行一次攻擊，若是命中敵人則累積一顆狂怒球。帶著狂怒球的狀態下將會增加你的攻擊速度。
hiddenEn: Perform a strike with a melee weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 混沌
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,混沌
對敵人釋放一種邪惡的瘟疫，對其造成持續的混沌傷害。如果一個敵人在受到傳染的影響下死亡，該減益效果將傳播到其他敵人，但每次傳播時，傷害僅為之前的四分之三。
hiddenEn: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies, but each time it spreads, it only deals three quarters as much damage as before.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 混沌
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,混沌
對敵人釋放一種邪惡的瘟疫，對其造成持續的混沌傷害。如果一個敵人在受到傳染的影響下被擊中，該減益效果將傳播到其他敵人。
hiddenEn: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy is hit while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 範圍效果
用劍或斧頭旋轉以在你附近的區域造成傷害。若你至少有 10 層盛怒，製造一個繞著你的盛怒風暴，根據你的攻擊速度，持續對範圍內的敵人造成攻擊傷害。盛怒風暴以加速的速率消耗盛怒，並在你盛怒用盡時結束。
hiddenEn: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. If you have at least 10 rage, create a ragestorm attached to you that repeatedly deals attack damage to enemies inside based on your attack speed. The ragestorm consumes rage at an accelerating rate, and ends if you run out.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 冰冷
使用念能力複製你的盾牌並當做投射物，但無法穿透，造成副手增強盾牌閃避傷害。當它碰觸到東西時會粉碎，並對各個方向發射小碎片投射物。
hiddenEn: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the evasion of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 物理
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,物理
揮斬兩次，釋放出擊中的敵人的衝擊波。在斬擊中間的敵人可能會被兩者都擊中。限定單手斧或單手劍。
hiddenEn: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a One Handed Axe or One Handed Sword.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰
揮斬兩次，釋放出擊中的敵人的寬泛衝擊波。在斬擊中間的敵人可能會被兩者都擊中。限定雙手斧或雙手劍。
hiddenEn: Slashes twice, releasing wide waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a Two Handed Axe or Two Handed Sword.

hiddenZh: 火焰, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
火焰,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
猛擊地面，消耗全部耐力球並在你前方釋放熾熱的裂縫，造成範圍傷害並從中產生數個更小的裂縫。限定錘、權杖、劍、斧、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Slam the ground, consuming all Endurance Charges and unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Sword, Axe, Staff, or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 持續時間
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,持續時間
重擊地面，發出長方形的裂縫對範圍內敵人造成傷害，並在結束時從地面刺出大型尖刺。你或友方玩家在尖刺附近使用戰吼或其他重擊技能會使尖刺粉碎，對附近敵人造成傷害。限定錘、權杖、斧、長杖和空手。
hiddenEn: Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 持續時間
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,持續時間
重擊地面，發出長方形的裂縫對範圍內敵人造成傷害，並在結束時從地面刺出尖刺。在一段時間後尖刺會碎裂，對附近敵人造成傷害。限定錘、權杖、斧、長杖和空手。
hiddenEn: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電
釋放 1 個光束，對你面前一長條的敵人造成閃電傷害，並有些許光束從它分歧出來，擊中旁邊更多敵人。
hiddenEn: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電
釋放 1 個集中光束，對你前方大範圍造成閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Release a concentrated beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理
攻擊,近戰,打擊,範圍效果,持續時間,物理
用強力的近戰攻擊攻擊敵人，同時也會傷害你。連續使用將提高對敵人和對你造成的傷害。用打擊擊暈敵人時會釋放一個傷害型脈衝。限定錘、權杖、斧或長杖。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, AoE, Duration, Physical

Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 範圍效果
攻擊,近戰,打擊,範圍效果
用強力的近戰攻擊攻擊敵人。用打擊擊暈敵人時會釋放一個傷害型脈衝。限定錘、權杖、斧或長杖。
hiddenEn: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 重擊, 近戰, 範圍效果, 閃電
攻擊,重擊,近戰,範圍效果,閃電
重擊地面，消耗所有暴擊球並自空中召喚數波神聖之錘，由內而外以螺旋軌跡接連砸下。每消耗一個暴擊球，便會更進一步的呼喚更多神聖之錘。需求錘、權杖、或長杖。
hiddenEn: Slam the ground, consuming all Power Charges and calling down a cascade of holy hammers from above in an outward spiral. Further hammers are called down for each Power Charge consumed. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 閃電, 持續時間
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,閃電,持續時間
使用雙手錘或長杖在範圍內橫掃，在持續時間內呼喚數波神聖之錘落下。無法被多重打擊輔助。
hiddenEn: Swings a two handed mace or a staff in a circle, calling down waves of holy hammers for a duration. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

hiddenZh: 圖騰, 法術, 投射物, 火焰, 引導, 物理, 範圍效果
圖騰,法術,投射物,火焰,引導,物理,範圍效果
召喚一個圖騰，它會持續的對附近的敵人噴射火焰，並在圖騰附近製造奉獻地面區域。
hiddenEn: Totem, Spell, Projectile, Fire, Channelling, Physical, AoE
Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.

hiddenZh: 範圍效果, 攻擊, 物理, 持續時間, 火焰, 球體
範圍效果,攻擊,物理,持續時間,火焰,球體
由你的盾牌向目標位置發射一道神聖光束，引發聖能內爆。此能量會以球體的型態停留短暫的時間，週期性的釋放更加劇烈的爆炸。對攻擊速度的增減會影響爆炸出現的頻率。
hiddenEn: AoE, Attack, Physical, Duration, Fire, Orb

Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration as an orb, periodically releasing larger explosions. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which explosions occur.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 混沌, 投射物
法術,範圍效果,混沌,投射物
在目標位置附近發射一個爆炸投射物，並向你附近的敵人發射額外投射物。 投射物會根據你的能量護盾造成混沌傷害。 施放此法術會對你造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,弓箭
對空射出無數箭矢，並在一段時間後接連落下，起始點在你的前方，並且沿著朝向目標的方向形成一條直線。每支箭矢對其附近區域造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting in front of you and proceeding in a line in the direction of the target. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,弓箭
對空射出無數箭矢，並在一段延遲時間後接連落下，起始點在目標位置，向所有方向擴散。每支箭矢在其附近區域造成傷害。如果在它們的射程範圍內有目標，其中一半的箭矢將直接命中目標。
hiddenEn: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to slowly land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 法術, 範圍效果, 引導, 物理
閃電,法術,範圍效果,引導,物理
引導施放吸收你附近的能量，不斷累積疊層。向前方釋放此能量光束。範圍效果詞綴不影響此技能。疊層上限為 10。
hiddenEn: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages. Release to unleash this energy in a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect this skill. Maximum of 10 Stages.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 法術, 範圍效果, 引導, 物理
閃電,法術,範圍效果,引導,物理
引導施放吸收你附近的能量，不斷累積疊層，每當這樣做時對附近的多個敵人造成傷害。在你身邊釋放此能量光束。疊層上限為 10。
hiddenEn: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a powerful burst around you. Maximum of 10 Stages.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 混沌, 持續時間, 投射物, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,混沌,持續時間,投射物,弓箭
朝空中發射數個箭矢並在目標區域如雨般降下，對擊中的敵人造成傷害並於它們降下的地方製造黴孢。每個黴孢對附近敵人造成混沌持續傷害並凋零它們，使它們增加承受混沌傷害。短暫時間過後，黴孢會爆炸造成範圍傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Chaos, Duration, Projectile, Bow

Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and withers them, causing them to take increased chaos damage. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 混沌, 持續時間, 投射物, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,混沌,持續時間,投射物,弓箭
朝空中發射數個箭矢並在目標區域如雨般降下，對擊中的敵人造成傷害並於它們降下的地方製造黴孢。每個黴孢對附近敵人減緩移動速度。短暫時間過後，黴孢會爆炸造成範圍傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Chaos, Duration, Projectile, Bow

Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod slows the movement speed of nearby enemies. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 混沌, 弓箭
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,混沌,弓箭
射出一發帶有腐蝕效果的箭矢，落地時對範圍造成混沌傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires a poisonous arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 持續時間, 物理
攻擊,近戰,打擊,持續時間,物理
對目標進行一個放血攻擊，對其造成一個流血的減益效果，效果可被作用期間詞綴影響。限定匕首、爪與劍。
hiddenEn: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with daggers, claws or swords.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰
目標附近的屍體爆炸造成小範圍傷害，並製造一個熔核朝附近敵人移動造成較大的範圍傷害。屍體爆炸不受法術屬性影響且不能被反射。
hiddenEn: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,火焰,持續時間
目標附近的屍體爆炸造成小範圍傷害，並製造一個熔核，在一段時間後爆炸，造成較大的範圍傷害。屍體爆炸不受法術屬性影響且不能被反射。
hiddenEn: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which detonates after a duration, dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

hiddenZh: 法術, 混沌, 範圍效果, 引導, 持續時間
法術,混沌,範圍效果,引導,持續時間
對你前方的敵人套用一個減益效果，對其造成持續的混沌傷害。那些尚未受到萎滅減益的敵人還會在較短的次要時間內受到阻礙效果，減緩其移動速度。持續引導將為減益效果添加傷害層，每層都有自己的持續時間。造成傷害的減益效果可由瘟疫擴散。
hiddenEn: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. The damaging debuff is spread by Contagion.

hiddenZh: 法術, 混沌, 範圍效果, 引導, 持續時間
法術,混沌,範圍效果,引導,持續時間
對你前方的敵人套用一個減益效果，對其造成持續的混沌傷害。那些尚未受到萎滅減益的敵人還會在較長的次要時間內受到阻礙效果，減緩其移動速度並降低其生命回復率。持續引導將為減益效果添加傷害層，每層都有自己的持續時間。
hiddenEn: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a longer secondary duration, slowing their movement and reducing their life regeneration rate. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理, 混沌, 球體
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,物理,混沌,球體
製造一個虛無玉，阻礙它附近的敵人，越靠近它的敵人會受到更強大的減益效果。它同時會定期釋放範圍傷害的脈衝。虛無玉會吞噬在他附近死亡敵人的屍體。同時只能有一個虛無玉。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Duration, Physical, Chaos, Orb

Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 法術, 範圍效果, 物理
暴擊,法術,範圍效果,物理
從天空降下的虛空武器，對敵人連續發射造成傷害。敵人可被擊中複數次。
hiddenEn: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 法術, 範圍效果, 物理
暴擊,法術,範圍效果,物理
從天空降下的虛空武器，對敵人連續發射造成傷害。每次降下的範圍都更廣，傷害也更大。敵人可被擊中複數次。
hiddenEn: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys, each wider and more damaging than the last. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 物理
向前依圓形射出虛空匕首，造成物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 物理, 持續時間
法術,投射物,物理,持續時間
向前依弧形射出虛空匕首，造成物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 冰冷
陷阱,法術,持續時間,範圍效果,冰冷
投擲一個陷阱對會附近的敵人發射減益狀態射線持續一段時間。射線會使敵人冰緩並造成冰冷持續傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰
對前方區域攻擊。每個擊中敵人的衝擊波獲得疊層。若是一段時間內沒有使用衝擊波擊中敵人時會開始失去疊層。限定匕首、爪、單手劍。
hiddenEn: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 弓箭
對不同的目標射出會裂化的箭矢。
hiddenEn: Fires an arrow that splits to hit different targets.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
重擊地面並製造出一道向前釋放的衝擊波，被此衝擊波擊中的敵人將會受到傷害並有較高機率被擊暈。衝擊波對近距離的敵人造成更多傷害。限定雙手斧、雙手錘或長杖。
hiddenEn: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wide wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. Requires a Two Handed Axe, Two Handed Mace, or Staff.

hiddenZh: 物理, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
物理,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
使用你的武器打擊地面，使矛從地面連續刺出，可以擊中敵人多次。
hiddenEn: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spikes from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
使用你的武器打擊地面，使矛從地面刺出。在血腥姿態時，這些矛會在你指定的位置貫穿多次，在沙戮姿態時，從指定位置向四方進行貫穿。限定劍和斧。預設血腥姿態。
hiddenEn: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 冰冷, 閃電, 新星
法術,範圍效果,火焰,冰冷,閃電,新星
釋放角色身上所有的充能球並對周圍所有敵人造成元素傷害。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Nova
Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 閃電, 持續時間, 烙印
法術,範圍效果,物理,閃電,持續時間,烙印
製造 1 個可以附著附近敵人的魔幻烙印。當附著時會定期啟動，對烙印的敵人附加能量，也會對附近沒有能量的敵人附加。當烙印掉落時，全部有能量的敵人都會被傷害。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Physical, Lightning, Duration, Brand

Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 閃電, 持續時間, 烙印
法術,範圍效果,物理,閃電,持續時間,烙印
製造 1 個可以附著附近敵人的魔幻烙印。當附著時會定期啟動，對烙印的敵人附加能量，脈衝會對烙印的敵人和它附近造成傷害。根據烙印敵人身上的能量，最多 20 層，脈衝會獲得範圍效果和傷害。當烙印脫離時，移除敵人身上全部能量。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Physical, Lightning, Duration, Brand

Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間, 物理, 閃電, 範圍效果
法術,召喚物,持續時間,物理,閃電,範圍效果
對範圍內敵人造成傷害，套用一小段時間的減益效果。若非傳奇敵人被此減益效果影響時死亡，屍體會被消耗來召喚 1 個二階持續時間的赦免護衛，或是若你的護衛數量達最大上限，則刷新現有的生命和持續時間。
hiddenEn: Spell, Minion, Duration, Physical, Lightning, AoE

Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 位移, 快行, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,位移,快行,重擊
短跳至空中，並在落地時以你的武器重擊並擊退範圍內的敵人。被踩到的敵人將會被推出去。限定斧、錘、權杖、劍或是長杖。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Movement, Travel, Slam

Jump a short distance through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 範圍效果, 火焰
攻擊,近戰,範圍效果,火焰
揮舞你的盾牌，在你面前形成三道衝擊波造成範圍傷害。敵人可以被兩個重疊的衝擊波擊中。
hiddenEn: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 投射物, 範圍效果, 連鎖, 三相
攻擊,近戰,打擊,閃電,冰冷,火焰,投射物,範圍效果,連鎖,三相
使用近戰武器打擊敵人，將部分傷害轉換為隨機的元素傷害。根據轉換成的元素釋放出爆破、閃電或冰霜。會避免連續選擇相同的元素。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Projectile, AoE, Chaining, Prismatic

Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 閃電
陷阱,法術,持續時間,範圍效果,閃電
投擲一個陷阱，一旦被觸發將會在範圍內落下多道雷電持續一段時間，造成閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 閃電
陷阱,法術,持續時間,範圍效果,閃電
投擲一個陷阱，一旦被觸發將會在範圍內落下多道雷電持續一段時間，造成閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 物理, 持續時間
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,物理,持續時間
揮舞斧或劍，消耗鋼鐵碎片以獲得鐵牢，保護你一段時間，並發射撞擊時會粉碎的投射物，或是發射時就粉碎。對它們碎裂位置前方造成範圍傷害。鋼鐵碎片可以透過鋼之呼喚取得。
hiddenEn: Swing an Axe or Sword, consuming Steel Shards to gain a Steel Ward that protects you for a duration, and fire projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

hiddenZh: 向前突刺斧或劍，在你前面形成一團碎片。這團碎片將依次發射多個投射物，瞄準前方或附近的敵人。
hiddenEn: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 物理
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,物理
消耗鋼鐵碎片來發射單一投射物，在撞擊或抵達目標位置時裂化，當它裂化時會造成範圍傷害，裂化的投射物在飛行結束時會爆炸並再次造成範圍傷害。這個技能的投射物不會返回。需要劍或斧。鋼鐵碎片可透過鋼之呼喚技能來獲得。
hiddenEn: Consume Steel Shards to fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 召喚物, 持續時間, 位移, 快行, 弓箭
攻擊,召喚物,持續時間,位移,快行,弓箭
對目標地點射出一支箭，當箭到達時將你傳送至目標地，並在原地留下一個你的複製體。這個複製體使用跟你一樣的弓與箭袋來發射箭矢至空中，並在目標位置落下。
hiddenEn: Attack, Minion, Duration, Movement, Travel, Bow

Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 召喚物, 持續時間, 位移, 快行, 三相, 弓箭
攻擊,召喚物,持續時間,位移,快行,三相,弓箭
對目標地點射出一支箭，當箭到達時將你傳送至目標地，並在原地留下一個你的複製體。這個複製體使用跟你一樣的弓與箭袋來發射隨機元素箭矢，並將所有物理傷害轉為所選的元素傷害，且不會造成其他類型的傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, Minion, Duration, Movement, Travel, Prismatic, Bow

Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 位移, 持續時間
暴擊,攻擊,近戰,打擊,位移,持續時間
傳送至目標怪物身邊並用近戰武器對其造成傷害。若是未指定目標，則系統會為其隨機指定一隻怪物。釋放一顆狂暴擊能重置其技能冷卻。
hiddenEn: Critical, Attack, Melee, Strike, Movement, Duration

Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 近戰, 打擊, 閃電, 連鎖
攻擊,投射物,近戰,打擊,閃電,連鎖
在你揮舞近戰武器時凝聚閃電之力。除了轉換一部分物理傷害為閃電傷害，儲存的能量會在你揮舞時從武器釋放投射物，襲擊遠方的敵人並在它們之間連鎖。若近戰攻擊擊中目標，投射物不能被躲避。
hiddenEn: Attack, Projectile, Melee, Strike, Lightning, Chaining

Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as a projectile as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies and chain between them. The projectile cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 新星
法術,範圍效果,閃電,新星
在你的周圍施放環狀閃電，接著散發更大範圍的閃電新星。每次被擊中的敵人會受到閃電傷害。此效果會重複施放，且新星將會朝施放的方向行進。
hiddenEn: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This then repeats, with each repeat offset from the previous in the direction you target.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 閃電, 弓箭
射出一發充滿閃電能量的箭矢，箭矢擊中敵人時會造成電擊。它會卡在最終目標，使它們被電擊並重複造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning. It sticks into the final target, causing them to be struck and damaged multiple times.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 暴擊, 法術, 投射物, 閃電
陷阱,暴擊,法術,投射物,閃電
投擲一個陷阱，當敵人觸發時，陷阱會發射穿過敵人的投射物，對它們和後續的目標造成閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws a trap that launches projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
使用兩把武器對目標同時進行攻擊並造成傷害。限定雙持不同近戰武器來使用。
hiddenEn: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Requires dual-wielding two different melee weapon types to use.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
使用近戰武器對著目標進行兩次快速的攻擊，獲得疊層使此技能攻擊更快。當你移動時失去全部疊層。
hiddenEn: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, gaining stages which cause this skill to attack faster. All stages are lost when you move.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 物理
使用近戰武器對著目標進行兩次快速的攻擊。
hiddenEn: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.

hiddenZh: 範圍效果, 引導, 攻擊, 近戰, 閃電
範圍效果,引導,攻擊,近戰,閃電
引導一個你駕馭的幻象。當它移動時你獲得層數，直到到達最大距離。你和幻影之間會根據你的攻擊速度不斷釋放脈衝傷害。停止引導後將會傳送至幻影位置，並造成最後一波傷害。限定近戰武器。
hiddenEn: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 近戰, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 打擊
閃電,近戰,攻擊,範圍效果,打擊
使用近戰攻擊，使閃電擊中附近敵人，造成範圍傷害。每個目標只能被此技能擊中一次。限定劍、斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 閃電, 連鎖, 球體
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,閃電,連鎖,球體
套用一個增加感電機率的增益效果。當你有此增益效果感電敵人時，製造一個能量領域附著至感電的敵人持續一段時間，並對附近敵人造成雷電光束傷害。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Duration, Lightning, Chaining, Orb

Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning.

hiddenZh: 一道電弧從施放者射向目標，並同時裂化擊中其他敵人。
hiddenEn: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and splits to simultaneously hit several other enemies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 連鎖, 閃電
一道電弧從施放者射向目標，並會彈跳至另其他目標。每次電弧連鎖，它還會生成一條二段電弧，連鎖到主要電弧尚未擊中的另一個敵人，但這條二段電弧不能再進一步連鎖。
hiddenEn: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy, but this secondary arc cannot chain further.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 弓箭
閃電,攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,弓箭
發射迅速消逝的三支電流箭矢，如果箭矢的飛行被撞擊到目標而停止，它們將在目標後方創造一道閃電爆發，對敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. If the arrows' flight is stopped by colliding with a target, they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone behind the target

hiddenZh: 閃電, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 弓箭
閃電,攻擊,範圍效果,弓箭
從你的弓中創造出一道閃電爆發，不發射箭矢，但對你前方的扇形範圍內的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Create a burst of lightning from your Bow, firing no arrows but damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 閃電
法術,投射物,持續時間,閃電
向四面八方施放出多顆變幻莫測的電球，這些電球將會隨機移動直到撞到敵人或是自然消失。
hiddenEn: Launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 閃電
法術,投射物,持續時間,閃電
施放出多顆變幻莫測的電球，它們有著不同的速度和距離，這些電球將會隨機移動直到撞到敵人或是自然消失。
hiddenEn: Launches unpredictable sparks with that move randomly with large differences in speed and distance until they hit an enemy or expire.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 引導
法術,範圍效果,閃電,引導
你引導施放此技能時，技能釋放電能脈衝，對你面前弧狀區域內的所有敵人造成傷害，範圍會逐漸擴大。
hiddenEn: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a growing semicircular area in front of you.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 引導
暴擊,法術,範圍效果,閃電,引導
你引導施放此技能時，技能釋放電能脈衝，對你面前弧狀區域內的所有敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 持續時間, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,持續時間,重擊
猛擊地面，對附近區域造成傷害並裂開地面。在一段時間後，裂縫將爆發為強力的餘震。在第一個裂縫爆發之前製造的裂縫將不會產生自己的餘震。限定斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 圖騰, 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 新星
圖騰,法術,範圍效果,物理,新星
召喚一根圖騰，它會持續震動你附近的地面，對敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around you, damaging enemies.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷
暴擊,法術,範圍效果,冰冷
在指定地點製造瞬間冰爆，對範圍內敵人造成傷害。可以消耗 1 顆暴擊球無視冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

hiddenZh: 法術, 位移, 冰冷, 快行, 範圍效果
法術,位移,冰冷,快行,範圍效果
傳送至指定的位置，對你初始和最終位置的敵人造成傷害。對冰緩的敵人造成更多傷害，然後移除它們的冰緩。不能被釋放輔助。
hiddenEn: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies in an area at both ends of the teleport. Deals higher damage to chilled enemies, then removes chill from them. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 召喚物, 持續時間, 近戰, 打擊
攻擊,召喚物,持續時間,近戰,打擊
使用近戰攻擊打擊敵人，給予一小段時間的減益效果。若非傳奇敵人在減益效果持續時間內死亡，敵人的屍體將會被消耗並召喚一個相同稀有度和前後綴的統御護衛，持續一段時間。
hiddenEn: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.

hiddenZh: 投擲你近戰武器的無形靈體版本。此靈體將會向外飛並變成有形的返回到你的身邊，只在返回時以旋轉攻擊擊中和傷害敵人。
hiddenEn: Throws an intangible spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then becomes tangible as it returns to you, in a spinning attack that only hits and damages enemies while returning.

hiddenZh: 混沌, 法術, 投射物
發射一個投射物，對擊中的敵人造成混沌傷害，並造成的部分偷取為能量護盾。
hiddenEn: Fires a projectile that deals chaos damage to enemies it hits and leeches some of that damage as energy shield.

hiddenZh: 混沌, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 投射物
混沌,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,投射物
發射一個螺旋投射物向敵人前近並穿透他們，且造成的部分傷害偷取為能量護盾。此投射物也會對它沿路上的敵人造成短時間但強力的混沌持續傷害減益效果。
hiddenEn: Fires a series of projectiles in a spiral that turn towards enemies in front of them, damaging and piercing through those they hit, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectiles travel, they repeatedly apply a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around them.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 混沌, 範圍效果
法術,投射物,持續時間,混沌,範圍效果
投射出一個造成持續性混沌傷害減益效果的投射物。你失去等同於減益傷害的生命和能量護盾。減益效果可以透過瘟疫擴散。
hiddenEn: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 混沌, 範圍效果
法術,投射物,持續時間,混沌,範圍效果
投射出一個造成持續性混沌傷害減益效果的穿透投射物。一部分減益效果的傷害將會回你的生命。
hiddenEn: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 法術, 範圍效果, 連鎖, 球體
閃電,法術,範圍效果,連鎖,球體
創造出一個帶電球體，放置時在其範圍內以電光打擊敵人，當你在其範圍內使用閃電技能時也會觸發電光。電光可裂化並擊中更多敵人。當電光擊中敵人時，球體會傳送至隨機一個被擊中的敵人位置。再次使用技能會取代原先的球體。
hiddenEn: Creates an electrical orb that will strike enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning when placed, as well as when you use a lightning skill while within its area. These beams of lightning can then split to hit more enemies. When striking enemies, this orb will teleport to a random enemy struck. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 法術, 範圍效果, 連鎖, 持續時間, 烙印
閃電,法術,範圍效果,連鎖,持續時間,烙印
製造一個可以附著於附近敵人的魔法烙印。當附著時，會定期發動向附近敵人和他們周圍發射一道光束造成傷害。當敵人死亡時烙印會掉落。
hiddenEn: Lightning, Spell, AoE, Chaining, Duration, Brand

Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing a beam which deals damage to the branded enemy and those around it. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 引導, 閃電, 持續時間, 秘能, 位移, 快行, 閃現
法術,範圍效果,引導,閃電,持續時間,秘能,位移,快行,閃現
引導施放以使在地面上的符文擴散。符文在一段時間後消逝，或被符文爆破引爆時立即消失並造成圓形範圍傷害。站在符文上的敵人被阻礙，減少他們的移動速度。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Channelling, Lightning, Duration, Arcane, Movement, Travel, Blink

Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

hiddenZh: 範圍效果, 法術, 閃電, 引導, 持續時間, 物理
範圍效果,法術,閃電,引導,持續時間,物理
當你引導施放時釋放能量球，能量球會遠離目標區域重複彈跳，直到它們的持續時間結束，並在每次跳躍後對小範圍造成傷害。當你停止引導時，所有存留的球會引爆，對大範圍造成較高傷害。
hiddenEn: AoE, Spell, Lightning, Channelling, Duration, Physical

Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump away from the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 物理
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,物理
這個法術創造出一群虛空的刀刃，它們短暫地繞著你附近形成一個區域，每 0.6 秒對附近的所有敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: This spell creates a swarm of ethereal blades which briefly orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 召喚物, 持續時間, 位移, 快行, 弓箭
攻擊,召喚物,持續時間,位移,快行,弓箭
對目標地點射出一支箭，當箭到達時在目標地創造一個你的複製體。這個複製體使用跟你一樣的弓與箭袋來發射箭矢至空中，並在目標位置落下。
hiddenEn: Attack, Minion, Duration, Movement, Travel, Bow
Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 召喚物, 持續時間, 位移, 快行, 三相, 弓箭
攻擊,召喚物,持續時間,位移,快行,三相,弓箭
對目標地點射出一支箭，當箭到達時會留下一個你的複製體。這個複製體使用跟你一樣的弓與箭袋來發射隨機元素箭矢，並將所有物理傷害轉為所選的元素傷害，且不會造成其他類型的傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, Minion, Duration, Movement, Travel, Prismatic, Bow

Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 弓箭
射出一支載有箭矢的箭，讓其飛入空中並落在目標位置。然後，它將從該點向所有方向發射箭矢。
hiddenEn: Fires a single payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. It will then fire arrows out in all directions from that point.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 物理, 範圍效果, 球體, 火焰, 冰冷, 閃電, 三相
法術,持續時間,物理,範圍效果,球體,火焰,冰冷,閃電,三相
製造1道隨機元素的龍捲風，干擾並持續傷害附近的敵人。龍捲風會將物理傷害轉為其元素，還會追擊敵人一小段時間。
hiddenEn: Spell, Duration, Physical, AoE, Orb, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Prismatic
Create a Tornado of a random element that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it, converting physical damage to its element. The Tornado will chase down enemies for a duration.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 光環
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,光環
施展治癒你和友方的光環，治癒量等同所受的元素傷害量。
hiddenEn: Casts an aura that causes taking elemental damage to heal you and nearby allies instead.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 守護
法術,持續時間,瓦爾,守護
消耗耐力球，根據消耗的耐力球，使你的角色在一段時間無法死亡或無法獲得瓦爾靈魂。
hiddenEn: Discharges Endurance Charges, making the character unable to die or gain Vaal souls for a short time, proportional to how many endurance charges were expended.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 冰冷
光環,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,冰冷
施放一個光環使你和附近的隊友減少承受冰冷傷害和免疫冰凍、冰緩，並擊中附近的敵人時無視他們的冰冷抗性。
hiddenEn: Aura, Spell, AoE, Duration, Vaal, Cold
Casts an aura that reduces cold damage taken and provides freeze and chill immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their cold resistance.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 火焰
光環,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,火焰
施放一個光環使你和附近的隊友減少承受火焰傷害和免疫點燃，並擊中附近的敵人時無視他們的火焰抗性。
hiddenEn: Aura, Spell, AoE, Duration, Vaal, Fire
Casts an aura that reduces fire damage taken and provides ignite immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their fire resistance.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 閃電
光環,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,閃電
施放一個光環使你和附近的隊友減少承受閃電傷害和免疫感電，並擊中附近的敵人時無視他們的閃電抗性。
hiddenEn: Aura, Spell, AoE, Duration, Vaal, Lightning
Casts an aura that reduces lightning damage taken and provides shock immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their lightning resistance.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾
光環,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾
施放一個短暫的光環，使你與受光環影響友方獲得閃避攻擊和對你壓抑的法術傷害很不幸的能力。
hiddenEn: Casts a temporary aura that grants you and your allies additional chance to evade attacks, and makes suppressed spell damage unlucky against you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 圖騰, 近戰, 範圍效果, 瓦爾, 重擊
攻擊,圖騰,近戰,範圍效果,瓦爾,重擊
召喚一個當你在附近時會使用強力連震攻擊的先祖圖騰。若敵人距離很遠，攻擊將會帶有躍擊使它靠近敵人。靠近時給予你更多近戰傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, Totem, Melee, AoE, Vaal, Slam

Summons an Ancestor Totem which attacks enemies with a powerful cascading slam while you're near it. If the enemies are far away, it will leap toward them as it slams. Being near it grants you more melee damage. Requires a Melee Weapon or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 瓦爾, 冰冷
攻擊,近戰,打擊,持續時間,範圍效果,瓦爾,冰冷
凝聚冰霜之力，轉換一部分的物理傷害為冰冷傷害以重擊目標，同時在目標周圍造成一個不可侵犯、讓敵人無處可逃的冰牆。限定錘與長杖。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Duration, AoE, Vaal, Cold
Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. It traps enemies with you in a circle of ice so that they can't escape. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 瓦爾, 持續時間, 弓箭
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,冰冷,瓦爾,持續時間,弓箭
發射一支將部分物理傷害轉為冰冷傷害的箭矢，且在擊中敵人之後對其背後扇形範圍內的其他敵人造成等同全部物理傷害的冰冷傷害。當你使用次技能時，會召喚一群幻影神槍手一段時間。不能被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Attack, Projectile, AoE, Cold, Vaal, Duration, Bow

Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target. When you use this skill, it summons a squad of Mirage Sharpshooters for a duration. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 瓦爾, 冰冷, 新星
法術,範圍效果,瓦爾,冰冷,新星
一個冰冷之環在施法者四周膨脹，每次擊中敵人時會重複一次。
hiddenEn: A chilling circle of ice expands from the caster, repeating from every enemy it hits.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 引導, 近戰, 瓦爾
攻擊,範圍效果,引導,近戰,瓦爾
引導施放一個在你附近擴張的環形範圍，並致盲範圍內的敵人。當你引導施放時對環形中的每個敵人造成小範圍的傷害。限定匕首、爪或單手劍。
hiddenEn: Channel to create an expanding circle area around you that blinds enemies within it. When you stop channelling, deals damage in a smaller area around each enemy in the circle. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 瓦爾, 持續時間
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,瓦爾,持續時間
在身體前方以弧狀揮動武器（雙持時則揮動兩把武器），對前方區域的怪物造成傷害。對西有或傳奇敵人的致命一擊會給予一個增益效果，在一段時間內優化劈砍。對稀有敵人的致命一擊會偷取他們的詞綴。限定斧與劍。
hiddenEn: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Killing Blows on Rare or Unique enemies grant a buff that improves Cleave for a duration. Killing Blows on Rare Enemies also steal their modifiers for a secondary duration. Only works with Axes and Swords.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 攻擊, 投射物, 瓦爾
揮動你的法杖同時攻擊附近的所有敵人。瀕死的敵人將會被撲殺，並產生同等數量的暴擊球。不能被齊射輔助。
hiddenEn: Fires your wand simultaneously at all nearby enemies, culling those close to death and granting you a power charge for each. Cannot be supported by Volley.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間, 瓦爾
法術,召喚物,持續時間,瓦爾
召喚一支由強大的骷髏將軍所統率，由骷髏戰士、骷髏弓箭手與骷髏法師所組成的骷髏大軍。
hiddenEn: Summons an army of skeletal soldiers, archers and mages, led by a powerful general.

hiddenZh: 圖騰, 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 瓦爾
圖騰,光環,法術,範圍效果,瓦爾
召喚一個圖騰，它會施放一個光環並使你與受光環影響友方獲得額外的生命回復。當在此光環影響下被擊中時，部分傷害會從圖騰的生命扣除。
hiddenEn: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies. When things affected by the aura are hit, the totem's life is removed instead for some of the damage.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 瓦爾, 火焰
法術,範圍效果,瓦爾,火焰
指定屍體並對附近敵人造成法術傷害，同時引爆屍體造成火焰傷害。屍體爆炸不受法術傷害屬性影響，也無法被反射。此效果會持續瞄準其他附近屍體，並且每次間隔時間會增加，直到附近沒有屍體可以消耗或是總共摧毀22個屍體。
hiddenEn: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with an increasing delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 22 corpses.

hiddenZh: 持續時間, 召喚物, 法術, 瓦爾, 物理
持續時間,召喚物,法術,瓦爾,物理
操控一把近戰武器或剩餘的劍刃來為你而戰，並將它們轉換至不同的傳奇物品。不能幻化未鑑定的武器。不會幻化有 6 個插槽的武器。不能被陷阱或地雷使用。
hiddenEn: Animates multiple Melee Weapon Items and Lingering Blades to fight by your side, and transforms them into different, unique weapons. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.

hiddenZh: 法術, 物理, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾
法術,物理,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾
一把血腥鐮刀橫掃指定區域，物理傷害擊中敵人。在它們下方留下沸騰之血一段時間，並造成物理持續傷害。同時在二階持續時間給予最大血腥球加成。
hiddenEn: Bloody scythes swipe around a selected area, hitting enemies with physical damage. An area of boiling blood is left beneath them for a duration which deals physical damage over time. Also gives a bonus to maximum Blood Charges for a secondary duration.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 位移, 引導
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,持續時間,瓦爾,位移,引導
以自體為中心在原地進行旋轉攻擊，周圍的敵人將會被拉向你並受到傷害。當引導施放此技能時不會被暈眩或擊退。不能被殘暴輔助。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Duration, Vaal, Movement, Channelling
Spin and attack in place, damaging nearby enemies and pulling others towards you. While using this skill, you cannot be stunned or knocked back. Cannot be supported by Ruthless.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 冰冷, 瓦爾
法術,持續時間,冰冷,瓦爾
立刻將你保護在冰塊中，保護你一段時間或你承受一定次數的擊中，並在施放時間結束時給予一個增益效果。你不能在冰塊期間移動或施展非立即的行動。當冰塊破除後，增益效果也會被移除。
hiddenEn: Immediately encases you in ice, protecting you for a duration or until you take damage from a number of hits, and also grants a buff once the cast time has finished. You cannot move or perform non-instant actions while in the ice. When the ice breaks, the buff is also removed.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 瓦爾
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,瓦爾
將武器在身體周圍橫掃多次，並將部分怪物擊退。
hiddenEn: Repeatedly swings a two handed melee weapon in a circle, knocking back monsters away from the character.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 瓦爾, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,火焰,瓦爾,持續時間
獻祭你部分的生命和能量護盾，使你被魔法火焰吞噬並迅燃燒附近的敵人持續一段時間。你的法術傷害在此效果下會增加。
hiddenEn: Sacrifices a portion of your Life and Energy Shield to engulf you in magical fire that rapidly burns nearby enemies for a duration. Your spell damage is increased while under this effect.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 瓦爾
對目標進行一次強而有力的攻擊並把目標擊飛。限定斧、錘、劍或雙手武器。
hiddenEn: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow, sending them flying backwards. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Sword or Two-Handed Weapon.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾
光環,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾
施放一個短暫的光環，使你與受光環影響友方施放技能時無須消耗魔力。
hiddenEn: Casts a temporary aura that lets you and your allies cast skills without paying their mana costs.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 法術, 持續時間, 範圍效果, 瓦爾, 火焰
陷阱,法術,持續時間,範圍效果,瓦爾,火焰
投擲多個陷阱，陷阱被觸發時會爆炸並對周圍的敵人造成火焰傷害，且該區域的地面會持續燃燒，踩在上面的敵人會持續受到傷害。
hiddenEn: Trap, Spell, Duration, AoE, Vaal, Fire
Throws multiple traps that explode when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving areas of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through them.

hiddenZh: 投射物, 法術, 範圍效果, 瓦爾, 火焰
投射物,法術,範圍效果,瓦爾,火焰
以施法者為中心螺旋型散發大量的火球。
hiddenEn: Launches a series of fireballs in a spiral around the caster.

hiddenZh: 近戰, 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 重擊, 火焰, 瓦爾
近戰,攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,重擊,火焰,瓦爾
猛擊地面，製造一道曲折的裂縫，在向外蔓延時造成範圍傷害。當它到達目標位置時會爆發，釋放出熔岩投射物。爆發後，裂縫會持續向敵人移動再次爆發。限定斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Melee, Attack, Projectile, AoE, Slam, Fire, Vaal

Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 火焰, 瓦爾
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,火焰,瓦爾
固定數量的火球以螺旋落下，最終在衝擊中央目標位置。它們在撞擊地面時爆炸，對附近的敵人造成傷害並留下燃燒地面，造持火焰持續傷害。
hiddenEn: A fixed number of flaming bolts rain down in a spiral, culminating in the central one impacting the targeted location. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and leaving burning ground, which deals fire damage over time.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 瓦爾, 火焰, 引導
法術,範圍效果,瓦爾,火焰,引導
指定一塊區域，並在該區域根據施放速度累積層數。每堆疊 3 層會產生爆炸，直到 15 層。當層數越多時範圍越小，但傷害會越大。
hiddenEn: Targets an area and builds up stages in that area based on cast speed. It explodes every 3 stages, until it reaches a maximum of 15. As it gains more stages, the area gets smaller but the damage gets higher.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊, 火焰, 連鎖, 瓦爾
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,近戰,打擊,火焰,連鎖,瓦爾
為你的近戰武器注入熔岩之力，使你的攻擊帶有物理和火焰傷害。此攻擊使熔岩球向你擊中敵人的前方發射，在落點對敵人造成範圍傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, Projectile, AoE, Melee, Strike, Fire, Chaining, Vaal
Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth causing area attack damage to enemies where they land.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 火焰, 物理, 瓦爾, 守護
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,火焰,物理,瓦爾,守護
套用一個增益效果至你的護甲，在效果消逝前，你受到傷害前可以先承受部分擊中傷害。每秒根據你當時所承受的傷害，對附近敵人造成反射傷害。當增益效果消耗殆盡時，技能會對你附近的敵人造成反射傷害，此傷害根據此增益效果總共承受多少傷害而定。與其它守護技能共享冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Duration, Fire, Physical, Vaal, Guard

Applies a buff that raises your armour, and takes some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Each second, the skill deals reflected damage to surrounding enemies based on the damage taken by the buff in that second. When the buff is removed, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken by the buff. You cannot have the buff at the same time as any other Guard skill.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 瓦爾, 火焰, 弓箭
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,瓦爾,火焰,弓箭
射出一發帶有火焰能量的箭矢，接觸到敵人時會爆炸，並對其與周圍的敵人造成額外火焰傷害，同時有較高的機率造成點燃。
hiddenEn: Attack, Projectile, AoE, Vaal, Fire, Bow
Fires an arrow that explodes, dealing fire damage to its target and other nearby enemies, with an increased chance of igniting them.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 混沌, 持續時間, 瓦爾
攻擊,投射物,混沌,持續時間,瓦爾
在不先發射的情況下立即和在次要持續時間內，製造已接住的投射物。當你使用迴旋之刃時，接住的投射物會向外旋轉並不會返回。限定匕首或爪。
hiddenEn: Creates already-caught projectiles without firing them first, both immediately and over a secondary duration. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 瓦爾, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,瓦爾,弓箭
對空射出無數箭矢，並在一段時間後接連落下，最先降落於目標區域並擴散至外圍地區。每支箭矢都會對附近造成傷害。一半的箭矢會直接攻擊於範圍內的目標。
hiddenEn: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in multiple sequences after a delay, each starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾
光環,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾
施放一個短暫的光環，使你與受光環影響友方獲得額外的能量護盾，並且不會因為受到攻擊而延遲護盾的回復。
hiddenEn: Casts a temporary aura that prevents energy shield recharge being delayed by damage taken for you and your allies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 混沌, 瓦爾, 弓箭
攻擊,投射物,範圍效果,持續時間,混沌,瓦爾,弓箭
發射一支慢速蛇行的箭矢，造成混沌傷害並穿透敵人，留下腐蝕地面。站在腐蝕地面上的敵人受到混沌持續傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, Projectile, AoE, Duration, Chaos, Vaal, Bow
Fires a slow-moving serpentine arrow which deals chaos damage while piercing enemies, and leaves a trail of caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.

hiddenZh: 法術, 混沌, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 新星, 引導
法術,混沌,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,新星,引導
引導施放時對所有扇形範圍中的敵人疊加強力的減益效果，每層減益效果各自存在持續時間，並造成混沌持續傷害。敵人會持續受到較短的二階阻礙效果，減少他們的移動速度。
hiddenEn: Spell, Chaos, AoE, Duration, Vaal, Nova, Channelling

Apply a powerful debuff to enemies around you which deals chaos damage over time. Then applies two additional layers in a larger area, growing greatly in size each time. Enemies are also substantially hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement.

hiddenZh: 法術, 持續時間, 召喚物, 瓦爾
法術,持續時間,召喚物,瓦爾
攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 瓦爾
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,瓦爾
重複對不同方向進行範圍攻擊。每擊中一個敵人將會使瓦爾．衝擊波的範圍增大。若是一段時間內沒有使用瓦爾．衝擊波擊中敵人或是使用了其他技能，此範圍將會還原。限定匕首、爪、單手劍。
hiddenEn: Repeatedly attacks a large area in different directions. Each Vaal Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 瓦爾, 弓箭
DNT Fires multiple arrows which continuously fork as they fly.
hiddenEn: DNT Fires multiple arrows which continuously fork as they fly.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 瓦爾, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,瓦爾,重擊
重擊地面並製造出向周圍釋放具有傷害的衝擊波。衝擊波對近距離的敵人造成更多傷害。限定斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels in all directions that damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 此技能已被暫時進用且無法使用。
hiddenEn: This skill is temporarily disabled and cannot be used.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間, 物理, 閃電, 瓦爾, 範圍效果
法術,召喚物,持續時間,物理,閃電,瓦爾,範圍效果
昇華其中一個現有的赦免護衛，變得更加強大、獲得新法術和刷新它的持續時間，同時保留其它加成效果，包含輔助寶石。若你不能獲得更多昇華的赦免護衛，則會刷新一個現有護衛的持續時間。
hiddenEn: Spell, Minion, Duration, Physical, Lightning, Vaal, AoE

Causes one of your existing Sentinels of Absolution to Ascend, becoming more powerful, gaining new spells, and overriding its duration, while maintaining its other bonuses, including from support gems. If you cannot have more Ascended Sentinels of Absolution, an existing one will be refreshed instead.

hiddenZh: 光環, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾
光環,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾
施放一個短暫的光環，使你與受光環影響友方獲得額外移動速度、攻擊速度以及施放速度。
hiddenEn: Casts a temporary aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 位移, 瓦爾, 持續時間
攻擊,近戰,打擊,位移,瓦爾,持續時間
重複傳送至敵人並擊中他們，造成傷痕但沒有傷害。重複結束後，根據傷痕的總傷害來造成擊中並且移除。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Movement, Vaal, Duration
Repeatedly teleports to enemies and hits them, inflicting a wound but dealing no damage. After the repeating finishes, each enemy is hit by the total damage of their wounds, which are removed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 閃電, 位移, 快行
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,閃電,位移,快行
在指定位置施放一個法陣，在數秒之後將周圍的敵人傳送過去。當傳送時，在原本位置與傳送法陣位置的敵人都會受到閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Duration, Vaal, Lightning, Movement, Travel
Casts a delayed teleport for nearby enemies to a target destination. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the enemies both before and after they teleport.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 閃電, 投射物
攻擊,近戰,打擊,持續時間,瓦爾,閃電,投射物
凝聚閃電之力，轉換一部分的物理傷害為閃電傷害以重擊目標。凝聚之力會變成一顆球附著在你擊中的敵人身上，若你沒擊中敵人則會產生於地面上。這顆球會在一段時間內持續的發射投射物攻擊附近的敵人，也會對球體附著的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Duration, Vaal, Lightning, Projectile

Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy becomes an orb attached to the enemy you hit, or the ground if you don't hit an enemy. The orb will periodically fire projectiles at other nearby enemies for a duration, which will also damage the enemy the orb is attached to.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 閃電, 瓦爾, 弓箭
攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,閃電,瓦爾,弓箭
射出多支充滿閃電能量的箭矢，會在改變方向前不斷移動一小段時間。當它們擊中敵人時，使雷電擊中附近一群敵人。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Projectile, Lightning, Vaal, Bow
Fires charged arrows, which repeatedly travel for a short time before changing direction. When they hit enemies, they are struck by a bolt of lightning which damages a number of surrounding enemies.

hiddenZh: 陷阱, 暴擊, 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 閃電
陷阱,暴擊,法術,投射物,持續時間,瓦爾,閃電
投擲一個陷阱，該陷阱被觸發時將會向全方位散射出閃電投射物，投射物將會對觸發及接觸到的敵人造成閃電傷害，且同時在地面留下感電地面。
hiddenEn: Trap, Critical, Spell, Projectile, Duration, Vaal, Lightning
Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets and leaving a trail of shocked ground.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 物理
攻擊,近戰,打擊,持續時間,瓦爾,物理
使用近戰武器對著目標進行兩次快速的攻擊，每擊都會召喚你的影分身持續使用雙重打擊攻擊敵人一段時間。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Duration, Vaal, Physical
Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, each of which summons a double of you for a duration to continuously attack monsters in this fashion.

hiddenZh: 閃電, 近戰, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 打擊, 光環, 瓦爾
閃電,近戰,攻擊,範圍效果,持續時間,打擊,光環,瓦爾
呼喚雷電注入你的武器，進行近戰攻擊並使雷擊攻擊附近的敵人，造成範圍傷害。擊中敵人獲得一個光環，使你和你的友方獲得一段時間額外閃電傷害。限定劍、斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Lightning, Melee, Attack, AoE, Duration, Strike, Aura, Vaal

Calls lightning down to infuse your weapon, then performs a melee attack and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 連鎖, 瓦爾, 閃電, 持續時間
法術,連鎖,瓦爾,閃電,持續時間
一道感電的電弧從施放者射向目標，並會在多個目標間彈跳。每次射線連鎖會同時連鎖兩名敵人，但同一名敵人無法被擊中兩次。同時會獲得一個增益效果，你的電弧傷害在一小段時間內很幸運。
hiddenEn: A shocking arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains from an enemy, it will do so simultaneously to two further enemies, but never to enemies that have already been hit by any of these chains. Also grants a buff making your Arc damage lucky for a short duration.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 閃電
法術,投射物,持續時間,瓦爾,閃電
持續的施放出大量變幻莫測的電球，這些電球將會隨機移動直到撞到敵人或是自然消失。
hiddenEn: Continuously launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 重擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,持續時間,瓦爾,重擊
重擊地面，對周圍造成大量傷害，並在多處地面上留下裂痕。在一小段時間後裂痕會爆發成餘震。你的腳步會使先前已爆發裂痕的地面碎裂，對你附近造成傷害持續一段時間。此效果在第二階段持續時間後結束，或在最大次餘震後結束。限定斧、錘、權杖、長杖或空手。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Duration, Vaal, Slam

Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a short duration. After using this skill, your steps will deal damage around you, cracking the earth if the previous cracks have erupted. This effect ends after a secondary duration, or after a maximum number of aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 冰冷
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,冰冷
在你周圍製造瞬間冰爆，對敵人造成傷害。同時在你周圍製造一個擴散的冰緩區域，範圍內的敵人除了被冰緩也會受到冰冷持續傷害。敵人死於範圍內時獲得狂怒球，並且範圍內有敵人時你會獲得狂怒球。
hiddenEn: Creates a sudden burst of cold around you, damaging enemies. This also creates a chilling area around you which expands and deals cold damage over time to surrounding enemies in addition to chilling them. Enemies that die while in the area grant Frenzy Charges, and you will passively gain Frenzy Charges while there are enemies in the area.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
法術,召喚物,持續時間,瓦爾,攻擊,近戰,打擊
此法術會昇華你現有的統御護衛，變得更加強大、獲得新攻擊和刷新它的持續時間，同時保留它的怪物詞綴和其它加成，包含輔助寶石。若你不能獲得更多昇華的統御護衛，則會刷新一個現有護衛的持續時間。
hiddenEn: Spell, Minion, Duration, Vaal, Attack, Melee, Strike

This spell causes one of your existing Sentinels of Dominance to Ascend, becoming more powerful, gaining new attacks, and overriding its duration, while maintaining its monster modifiers and other bonuses, including from support gems. If you cannot have more Ascended Sentinels of Dominance, an existing one will be refreshed instead.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 瓦爾
使用念能力複製一把手中的近戰武器，並將此靈體投擲出去。他們飛出去然後回到你身邊，進行旋轉攻擊，對路徑上的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Throws several spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out and then return to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 閃電
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,閃電
在目標區域設置一個標記。在技能持續時間內，閃電將會持續隨機落雷標記附近的敵人，對其造成傷害。技能持續時間詞綴會影響每次落雷的間隔時間。當持續時間結束後，一道強力的閃電會攻擊那個標記，並對該標記周圍的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Sets a marker at a location. Lightning strikes random enemies around the marker repeatedly over the skill's duration, dealing damage in an area around the strike. Modifiers to the skill's duration will also affect the delay between these strikes. When the duration ends, a large bolt of lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it.

hiddenZh: 暴擊, 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 瓦爾, 物理
暴擊,法術,範圍效果,持續時間,瓦爾,物理
製造獨立行動的虛空刀刃持續一段時間。刀刃會飛向附近的敵人並持續穿透他們造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Critical, Spell, AoE, Duration, Vaal, Physical
Creates an independently-moving vortex of ethereal blades which lasts for a duration. The vortex moves toward nearby enemies, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.

ambientZh: 將其放置於物品上的插槽。點擊右鍵從插槽中取出。
將其放置於物品上的插槽來獲得這項技能。點擊右鍵從插槽中取出。
ambientEn: Place into an item socket. Right click to remove from a socket.
Place into an item socket to gain this skill. Right click to remove from a socket.
